SELECT 'UOM' AS kind, CAST(CAST(u.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(u.uom_name AS CHAR) AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM unit_of_measurement u
 WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND u.id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoUomIdsSql}}) AND u.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BATCH' AS kind, CAST(CAST(bt.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(bt.batch_number AS CHAR) AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM batch bt
 WHERE bt.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND bt.is_deleted = 0
   AND bt.id IN (SELECT b.batch_id FROM item_batch_balance b WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND b.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}}) AND b.unrestricted_qty > 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'HU' AS kind, '' AS id, CAST(CAST(hi.material_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, '' AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS n
  FROM handling_unit h
  JOIN handling_unit_atu7sreg_sub hi
    ON hi.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND hi.handling_unit_id = h.id AND hi.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND h.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND h.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0 AND (h.packing_id IS NULL OR h.packing_id = '') AND hi.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY hi.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'HURES' AS kind, '' AS id, CAST(CAST(r.material_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, '' AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM on_reserved_gd r
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND r.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'Allocated' AND r.handling_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND r.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY r.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PEND' AS kind, '' AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(CAST(r.parent_line_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM on_reserved_gd r
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND r.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'Pending' AND r.parent_line_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.soLineIdsQuoted}})
 GROUP BY r.parent_line_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LINK' AS kind, CAST(CAST(dl.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(dl.target_doc_id AS CHAR) AS v1, CAST(dl.buyer_org_id AS CHAR) AS v2, CAST(dl.seller_org_id AS CHAR) AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM document_linkage dl
 WHERE dl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND dl.is_deleted = 0 AND dl.target_doc_type = 'Sales Order' AND dl.link_status = 'Linked'
   AND CAST(dl.target_doc_id AS UNSIGNED) IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.soIdsSql}})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ITS' AS kind, CAST(CAST(its.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, '' AS v1, CAST(CAST(its.buyer_org_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS v2, CAST(CAST(its.seller_org_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS v3, '' AS v4, CAST(CAST(its.auto_create_gr AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q1, CAST(CAST(its.skip_picking AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM internal_trading_setup its
 WHERE its.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND its.is_deleted = 0 AND its.is_active = 1
   AND (its.buyer_org_id, its.seller_org_id) IN (SELECT CAST(dl.buyer_org_id AS UNSIGNED), CAST(dl.seller_org_id AS UNSIGNED)
                                                    FROM document_linkage dl
                                                   WHERE dl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND dl.is_deleted = 0 AND dl.target_doc_type = 'Sales Order' AND dl.link_status = 'Linked'
                                                     AND CAST(dl.target_doc_id AS UNSIGNED) IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.soIdsSql}}))
RESP: ['kind', 'id', 'material_id', 'location_id', 'batch_id', 'v1', 'v2', 'v3', 'v4', 'q1', 'q2', 'q3', 't1', 't2', 't3', 'j1', 'j2', 'n']

######## code_node_kyHUfWS3 [code-node] Auto allocation: the old save's GLOBAL_ALLOCATION loop (lifted node code) -> the lines' allocations, the bin / tuple id lists of the reads below
// GD_BULK_PREPARE - Auto allocation: the old Created save's GLOBAL_ALLOCATION loop for the lines with a quantity and no Select Stock (its node code, lifted; one set-based read instead of one call per line)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Read-only for business tables: it writes gd_async_job and
// gd_bulk_line_stage only.
function gaExecute(P, N) {
// 8dp is the maximum configurable column precision: rounding COMPUTED values there keeps
// every client-configured scale intact while killing float residue.
const q8 = (v) => Number((parseFloat(v) || 0).toFixed(8));
// Global Auto Allocation Workflow

const existingAllocationData = P.existingAllocationData || [];
const material_id = P.material_id;
const quantity = P.quantity;
const plant_id = P.plant_id;
const allocationStrategy = P.allocationStrategy || "RANDOM";
const isPending = P.isPending || 0;
const itemData = N.itemData;
const allocationType = P.allocationType || ""
const huData = P.huData || [];
const huPriority = P.huPriority || "HU First";
const currentDocId = P.currentDocId || "";
const enforceStockCheck = P.enforceStockCheck || 0;
const includeReservedQty = P.includeReservedQty || 0;
const orderUomId = P.orderUomId || "";
const splitPolicy = P.splitPolicy || "ALLOW_SPLIT";
const allowMixedItem = P.allowMixedItem ?? 1;
const lineMaterials = P.lineMaterials || [];

// UOM conversion: convert requested quantity to base UOM for comparison against balances
let conversionFactor = 1;
if (orderUomId && Array.isArray(itemData.table_uom_conversion)) {
  const uomConversion = itemData.table_uom_conversion.find(
    (conv) => conv.alt_uom_id === orderUomId
  );
  if (uomConversion && uomConversion.base_qty) {
    conversionFactor = parseFloat(uomConversion.base_qty);
  }
}
const baseQuantity = q8(quantity * conversionFactor);

let balanceData;
if (itemData.item_batch_management === 1) {
  balanceData = N.batchBalance || [];
} else {
  balanceData = N.itemBalance || [];
}

// Fetch HU reserved data from search node (on_reserved_gd with handling_unit_id)
const huReservedData = N.huReserved || [];

// Truncation guards: search-node fetch limits (raised in hardening stage 1a).
// If a balance/HU query returned a full page, the pool may be incomplete — fail
// loud rather than auto-allocating against partial data.
const BALANCE_FETCH_LIMIT = 500;
const HU_RESERVED_FETCH_LIMIT = 1000;
if (balanceData.length >= BALANCE_FETCH_LIMIT) {
  return { code: "400", message: `Balance rows for item ${itemData.material_code || material_id} reached the fetch limit (${BALANCE_FETCH_LIMIT}); cannot safely auto-allocate. Please contact support.`, allocationData: [], totalAllocated: 0 };
}
if (huReservedData.length >= HU_RESERVED_FETCH_LIMIT) {
  return { code: "400", message: `HU reservation rows for item ${itemData.material_code || material_id} reached the fetch limit (${HU_RESERVED_FETCH_LIMIT}); cannot safely auto-allocate. Please contact support.`, allocationData: [], totalAllocated: 0 };
}

// Build HU reservation map: handling_unit_id|batch_id -> total reserved open_qty (in base UOM)
// Exclude current GD's own records to avoid double deduction with existingAllocationData
const huReservedMap = {};
for (const r of huReservedData) {
  if (!r.handling_unit_id || parseFloat(r.open_qty) <= 0) continue;
  if (currentDocId && r.doc_id === currentDocId) continue;

  // Convert open_qty from order UOM to base UOM (GD follows SO UOM)
  const key = `${r.handling_unit_id}|${r.batch_id || ""}`;
  huReservedMap[key] = (huReservedMap[key] || 0) + parseFloat(r.open_qty) * conversionFactor;
}

// item_balance.unrestricted_qty includes physical HU stock (unreserved
// portion only; reserved was bucket-shifted to reserved_qty). Before
// injecting HU as virtual balance records below, subtract the same HU
// contribution from the loose balance rows to avoid double-counting the
// same physical stock.
if (Array.isArray(huData) && huData.length > 0) {
  const huQtyByLocation = {};
  for (const huItem of huData) {
    if (huItem.row_type !== "item") continue;
    const reservedKey = `${huItem.handling_unit_id}|${huItem.batch_id || ""}`;
    const reservedQty = huReservedMap[reservedKey] || 0;
    const unreservedQty = Math.max(
      0,
      (parseFloat(huItem.item_quantity) || 0) - reservedQty
    );
    if (unreservedQty <= 0) continue;
    const locKey = `${huItem.location_id}|${huItem.batch_id || ""}`;
    huQtyByLocation[locKey] = (huQtyByLocation[locKey] || 0) + unreservedQty;
  }
  for (const b of balanceData) {
    const locKey = `${b.location_id}|${b.batch_id || ""}`;
    const deduct = huQtyByLocation[locKey] || 0;
    if (deduct > 0) {
      b.unrestricted_qty = Math.max(
        0,
        (parseFloat(b.unrestricted_qty) || 0) - deduct
      );
      if (b.balance_quantity != null) {
        b.balance_quantity = Math.max(
          0,
          (parseFloat(b.balance_quantity) || 0) - deduct
        );
      }
    }
  }
}

// Inject HU items into balance pool as virtual balance records.
// Deduct already-reserved quantities from on_reserved_gd so virtual record
// reflects unreserved HU portion (same portion just subtracted from loose).
if (Array.isArray(huData) && huData.length > 0) {
  for (const huItem of huData) {
    if (huItem.row_type !== "item") continue;
    let available = parseFloat(huItem.item_quantity) || 0;

    // Deduct existing HU reservations from other GDs
    const reservedKey = `${huItem.handling_unit_id}|${huItem.batch_id || ""}`;
    const reservedQty = huReservedMap[reservedKey] || 0;
    if (reservedQty > 0) {
      available = Math.max(0, available - reservedQty);
    }

    if (available <= 0) continue;
    balanceData.push({
      location_id: huItem.location_id,
      batch_id: huItem.batch_id || null,
      material_id: huItem.material_id,
      unrestricted_qty: available,
      expired_date: huItem.expired_date || null,
      manufacturing_date: huItem.manufacturing_date || null,
      create_time: huItem.create_time || null,
      balance_id: huItem.balance_id || "",
      handling_unit_id: huItem.handling_unit_id,
      source: "hu",
    });
  }
}

// Filter out HU balances from HUs with foreign items
// NO_SPLIT: always filter | FULL_HU_PICK: only when allow_mixed_item=0
const shouldFilterForeignHUs =
  (splitPolicy === "NO_SPLIT" || (splitPolicy === "FULL_HU_PICK" && allowMixedItem === 0));

if (shouldFilterForeignHUs && lineMaterials.length > 0) {
  const gdMaterialSet = new Set(lineMaterials);

  // Group HU balance records by handling_unit_id
  const huItemsMap = {};
  for (const b of balanceData) {
    if (b.source !== "hu") continue;
    if (!huItemsMap[b.handling_unit_id]) huItemsMap[b.handling_unit_id] = [];
    huItemsMap[b.handling_unit_id].push(b);
  }

  // Find ineligible HUs (ones with items not in any GD line)
  const ineligibleHuIds = new Set();
  for (const [huId, items] of Object.entries(huItemsMap)) {
    const hasForeignItem = items.some((item) => !gdMaterialSet.has(item.material_id));
    if (hasForeignItem) ineligibleHuIds.add(huId);
  }

  // Remove ineligible HU balances
  if (ineligibleHuIds.size > 0) {
    balanceData = balanceData.filter(
      (b) => b.source !== "hu" || !ineligibleHuIds.has(b.handling_unit_id),
    );
  }
}

let pendingData = [];
if (isPending === 1) {
  pendingData = N.pending || [];
}

const PENDING_FETCH_LIMIT = 500;
if (pendingData.length >= PENDING_FETCH_LIMIT) {
  return { code: "400", message: `Pending reservation rows for item ${itemData.material_code || material_id} reached the fetch limit (${PENDING_FETCH_LIMIT}); cannot safely auto-allocate. Please contact support.`, allocationData: [], totalAllocated: 0 };
}

// Preserve the real unrestricted_qty before any inflation for display purposes
for (let i = 0; i < balanceData.length; i++) {
  if (balanceData[i].source === "hu") continue;
  balanceData[i].real_unrestricted_qty = parseFloat(balanceData[i].unrestricted_qty) || 0;
}

// Include reserved stock in available qty, but ONLY the portion THIS allocation
// can actually claim without needing a fresh Unrestricted subtract:
//   (a) pending records this GD/line will consume (re-pointed at commit, no movement), and
//   (b) this GD's own already-Allocated loose reserved at the bin (reclaimed on re-alloc).
// Counting the FULL reserved_qty column would also include OTHER documents' reservations,
// letting allocation place qty that the loop's UNRESTRICTED_TO_RESERVED subtract (real
// Unrestricted only) cannot honor -> deterministic mid-loop "Insufficient quantity".
// All quantities normalized to base UOM (pending/own-reserved are stored in order UOM).
const ownReservedData = currentDocId
  ? (N.ownReserved || [])
  : [];

if (includeReservedQty === 1 || (isPending === 1 && pendingData.length > 0)) {
  const claimableReservedByKey = {};
  const addClaimable = (locId, batchId, qtyOrderUom) => {
    const q = parseFloat(qtyOrderUom) || 0;
    if (q <= 0) return;
    const key = `${locId}|${batchId || ""}`;
    claimableReservedByKey[key] =
      (claimableReservedByKey[key] || 0) + q * conversionFactor;
  };
  // (a) consumable pending (open_qty, order UOM) — Production + SO for this line
  for (const p of pendingData) {
    addClaimable(p.bin_location, p.batch_id, p.open_qty);
  }
  // (b) this GD's own loose Allocated reserved (reserved_qty, order UOM)
  for (const r of ownReservedData) {
    if (r.handling_unit_id) continue;
    addClaimable(r.bin_location, r.batch_id, r.reserved_qty);
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < balanceData.length; i++) {
    if (balanceData[i].source === "hu") continue;
    const reservedQty = parseFloat(balanceData[i].reserved_qty) || 0;
    if (reservedQty <= 0) continue;
    const key = `${balanceData[i].location_id}|${balanceData[i].batch_id || ""}`;
    // Never add back more than is physically reserved at this bin.
    const inflate = Math.min(reservedQty, claimableReservedByKey[key] || 0);
    if (inflate > 0) {
      balanceData[i].unrestricted_qty =
        (parseFloat(balanceData[i].unrestricted_qty) || 0) + inflate;
    }
  }
}

const isBatchManaged = itemData.item_batch_management === 1;

// FIELD MAPPING BY ALLOCATION TYPE
const getFieldNames = () => {
  switch (allocationType) {
    case "GD":
      return { qtyField: "gd_quantity", locationField: "location_id" };
    case "PP":
      return { qtyField: "to_quantity", locationField: "location_id" };
    case "MR":
      return { qtyField: "issue_qty", locationField: "bin_location_id" };
    default:
      return { qtyField: "quantity", locationField: "location_id" };
  }
};

const { qtyField, locationField } = getFieldNames();

// HELPER FUNCTIONS

const generateKey = (locationId, batchId, handlingUnitId) => {
  let key;
  if (isBatchManaged) {
    key = `${locationId}-${batchId || "no_batch"}`;
  } else {
    key = `${locationId}`;
  }
  if (handlingUnitId) {
    key += `-hu-${handlingUnitId}`;
  }
  return key;
};

const buildExistingAllocationMap = (existingData) => {
  const map = {};
  if (Array.isArray(existingData)) {
    for (const existing of existingData) {
      const key = generateKey(existing.location_id, existing.batch_id, existing.handling_unit_id);
      // Convert existing allocation qty to base UOM for correct deduction against base UOM balances
      const qty = q8((parseFloat(existing.quantity) || 0) * conversionFactor);
      map[key] = (map[key] || 0) + parseFloat(qty);
    }
  }
  return map;
};

const adjustBalancesForExisting = (balances, existingMap) => {
  return balances.map((balance) => {
    const key = generateKey(balance.location_id, balance.batch_id, balance.handling_unit_id);
    const existingQty = existingMap[key] || 0;
    const originalQty = parseFloat(balance.unrestricted_qty) || 0;
    const adjustedQty = Math.max(0, originalQty - existingQty);

    return {
      ...balance,
      unrestricted_qty: adjustedQty,
      original_unrestricted_qty: originalQty,
    };
  });
};

// SORTING FUNCTIONS

// direction: 1 = ascending (first/earliest), -1 = descending (last/latest)
const sortByExpiry = (balanceArray, direction) => {
  return [...balanceArray].sort((a, b) => {
    if (isBatchManaged && a.expired_date && b.expired_date) {
      return (new Date(a.expired_date) - new Date(b.expired_date)) * direction;
    }
    // No expiry on both sides: fall back to manufacturing date, then create time
    if (isBatchManaged && a.manufacturing_date && b.manufacturing_date) {
      return (
        (new Date(a.manufacturing_date) - new Date(b.manufacturing_date)) * direction
      );
    }
    return (new Date(a.create_time) - new Date(b.create_time)) * direction;
  });
};

const sortByCreateTime = (balanceArray, direction) => {
  return [...balanceArray].sort((a, b) => {
    return (new Date(a.create_time) - new Date(b.create_time)) * direction;
  });
};

const sortByQty = (balanceArray, direction) => {
  return [...balanceArray].sort((a, b) => {
    return ((a.unrestricted_qty || 0) - (b.unrestricted_qty || 0)) * direction;
  });
};

const sortByClearBin = (balanceArray, requestedQty) => {
  return [...balanceArray].sort((a, b) => {
    const qtyA = a.unrestricted_qty || 0;
    const qtyB = b.unrestricted_qty || 0;
    const canClearA = qtyA <= requestedQty;
    const canClearB = qtyB <= requestedQty;

    if (canClearA && !canClearB) return -1;
    if (!canClearA && canClearB) return 1;
    return qtyA - qtyB;
  });
};

const getDefaultBin = () => {
  if (!itemData.table_default_bin?.length) return null;
  const entry = itemData.table_default_bin.find(
    (bin) => bin.plant_id === plant_id
  );
  return entry?.bin_location || null;
};

const allocateFromBalances = (balanceList, remainingQty) => {
  const allocated = [];
  let remaining = remainingQty;

  for (const balance of balanceList) {
    if (remaining <= 0) break;

    const availableQty = balance.unrestricted_qty || 0;
    if (availableQty <= 0) continue;

    const allocatedQty = Math.min(remaining, availableQty);

    const allocationRecord = {
      ...balance,
      [qtyField]: allocatedQty,
      // Use real_unrestricted_qty (before reserved inflation) for display
      unrestricted_qty:
        balance.real_unrestricted_qty != null
          ? balance.real_unrestricted_qty
          : balance.original_unrestricted_qty || balance.unrestricted_qty,
    };

    // For MR, rename location_id to bin_location_id
    if (allocationType === "MR") {
      allocationRecord.bin_location_id = balance.location_id;
    }

    allocated.push(allocationRecord);
    remaining -= allocatedQty;
  }

  return { allocated, remainingQty: remaining };
};

// Whole-HU allocation: takes full item_quantity from each HU balance, never partial
// Stops picking once remaining need is fulfilled (don't over-allocate beyond what's needed)
const allocateWholeHU = (balanceList, remainingQty) => {
  const allocated = [];
  let remaining = remainingQty;

  // Group HU item records by handling_unit_id, preserving strategy order
  // (first appearance in the sorted list = pick priority).
  const huOrder = [];
  const huGroups = {};
  for (const balance of balanceList) {
    if (balance.source !== "hu") continue;
    const huId = balance.handling_unit_id;
    if (!huGroups[huId]) {
      huGroups[huId] = [];
      huOrder.push(huId);
    }
    huGroups[huId].push(balance);
  }

  for (const huId of huOrder) {
    if (remaining <= 0) break; // current-material need met — stop picking HUs
    const items = huGroups[huId];

    // Qty of the CURRENT material in this HU — ONLY this counts toward the
    // line's need. Foreign items (other GD lines) sharing the HU must not
    // decrement remaining, else the line is falsely marked fulfilled.
    const currentMatQty = items.reduce(
      (sum, b) =>
        b.material_id === material_id ? sum + (b.unrestricted_qty || 0) : sum,
      0
    );
    if (currentMatQty <= 0) continue; // HU has none of the current material

    // Pick the WHOLE HU: emit every item record (foreign items are distributed
    // to their own lines at confirm time).
    for (const balance of items) {
      const availableQty = balance.unrestricted_qty || 0;
      if (availableQty <= 0) continue;
      const allocationRecord = {
        ...balance,
        [qtyField]: availableQty,
        unrestricted_qty:
          balance.real_unrestricted_qty != null
            ? balance.real_unrestricted_qty
            : balance.original_unrestricted_qty || balance.unrestricted_qty,
      };
      if (allocationType === "MR") {
        allocationRecord.bin_location_id = balance.location_id;
      }
      allocated.push(allocationRecord);
    }

    remaining -= currentMatQty; // Can go negative (excess of current material)
  }

  return { allocated, remainingQty: Math.max(0, remaining) };
};

// NO_SPLIT whole-HU allocation: takes full HU qty but SKIPS HUs that would exceed remaining need
// Falls back to loose stock for the remainder
const allocateWholeHUWithLimit = (balanceList, remainingQty) => {
  const allocated = [];
  let remaining = remainingQty;

  // Group HU item records by handling_unit_id, preserving strategy order.
  const huOrder = [];
  const huGroups = {};
  for (const balance of balanceList) {
    if (balance.source !== "hu") continue;
    const huId = balance.handling_unit_id;
    if (!huGroups[huId]) {
      huGroups[huId] = [];
      huOrder.push(huId);
    }
    huGroups[huId].push(balance);
  }

  for (const huId of huOrder) {
    if (remaining <= 0) break;
    const items = huGroups[huId];

    // Only the CURRENT material's qty gates and decrements the need; foreign
    // items sharing the HU never count toward this line.
    const currentMatQty = items.reduce(
      (sum, b) =>
        b.material_id === material_id ? sum + (b.unrestricted_qty || 0) : sum,
      0
    );
    if (currentMatQty <= 0) continue;

    // No over-pick (NO_SPLIT): skip the whole HU if its current-material qty
    // exceeds remaining need. Loose stock covers the remainder downstream.
    if (currentMatQty > remaining) continue;

    for (const balance of items) {
      const availableQty = balance.unrestricted_qty || 0;
      if (availableQty <= 0) continue;
      const allocationRecord = {
        ...balance,
        [qtyField]: availableQty,
        unrestricted_qty:
          balance.real_unrestricted_qty != null
            ? balance.real_unrestricted_qty
            : balance.original_unrestricted_qty || balance.unrestricted_qty,
      };
      if (allocationType === "MR") {
        allocationRecord.bin_location_id = balance.location_id;
      }
      allocated.push(allocationRecord);
    }

    remaining -= currentMatQty;
  }

  return { allocated, remainingQty: Math.max(0, remaining) };
};

const filterAvailableBalances = (balances) => {
  return balances.filter((b) => (b.unrestricted_qty || 0) > 0);
};

// PENDING ALLOCATION FUNCTION
const allocateFromPending = (pendingRecords, balances, requestedQty) => {
  const allAllocations = [];
  let remainingQty = requestedQty;

  // Sort pending: Production first, then Sales Order
  const sortedPending = [...pendingRecords].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.doc_type === "Production" && b.doc_type !== "Production") return -1;
    if (a.doc_type !== "Production" && b.doc_type === "Production") return 1;
    return 0;
  });

  for (const pending of sortedPending) {
    if (remainingQty <= 0) break;

    // Convert pending open_qty from order UOM to base UOM (all reserved records follow SO UOM)
    const pendingQtyRaw = parseFloat(pending.open_qty) || 0;
    if (pendingQtyRaw <= 0) continue;
    const pendingQty = q8(pendingQtyRaw * conversionFactor);

    // Find matching balance (pending uses bin_location, balance uses location_id)
    // Only match loose balances (no HU) since SO/Production pending doesn't reserve at HU level
    const matchingBalance = balances.find((b) => {
      const locationMatch = b.location_id === pending.bin_location;
      const huMatch = !b.handling_unit_id;
      if (isBatchManaged) {
        return locationMatch && b.batch_id === pending.batch_id && huMatch;
      }
      return locationMatch && huMatch;
    });

    if (matchingBalance) {
      const availableQty = matchingBalance.unrestricted_qty || 0;
      const allocatedQty = Math.min(remainingQty, pendingQty, availableQty);

      if (allocatedQty > 0) {
        const key = generateKey(matchingBalance.location_id, matchingBalance.batch_id, matchingBalance.handling_unit_id);

        // Check if already allocated to this location/batch
        const existingIdx = allAllocations.findIndex((a) => {
          return generateKey(a.location_id, a.batch_id, a.handling_unit_id) === key;
        });

        if (existingIdx >= 0) {
          allAllocations[existingIdx][qtyField] += allocatedQty;
        } else {
          const allocationRecord = {
            ...matchingBalance,
            [qtyField]: allocatedQty,
            unrestricted_qty:
              matchingBalance.real_unrestricted_qty != null
                ? matchingBalance.real_unrestricted_qty
                : matchingBalance.original_unrestricted_qty || matchingBalance.unrestricted_qty,
          };

          // For MR, rename location_id to bin_location_id
          if (allocationType === "MR") {
            allocationRecord.bin_location_id = matchingBalance.location_id;
          }

          allAllocations.push(allocationRecord);
        }

        remainingQty -= allocatedQty;

        // Reduce available qty for next iteration
        matchingBalance.unrestricted_qty = Math.max(
          0,
          matchingBalance.unrestricted_qty - allocatedQty
        );
      }
    }
  }

  return { allocated: allAllocations, remainingQty };
};

// ALLOCATION STRATEGIES

// Simple strategies: sort then allocate
const sortAndAllocate = (sortFn) => (availableBalances, requestedQty) => {
  return allocateFromBalances(sortFn(availableBalances), requestedQty);
};

const strategyFixedBin = (availableBalances, requestedQty) => {
  const defaultBin = getDefaultBin();
  const allAllocations = [];
  let remainingQty = requestedQty;

  if (defaultBin) {
    const defaultBinBalances = availableBalances.filter(
      (b) => b.location_id === defaultBin
    );
    const result1 = allocateFromBalances(sortByExpiry(defaultBinBalances, 1), remainingQty);
    allAllocations.push(...result1.allocated);
    remainingQty = result1.remainingQty;
  }

  if (remainingQty > 0) {
    const otherBalances = availableBalances.filter(
      (b) => !defaultBin || b.location_id !== defaultBin
    );
    const result2 = allocateFromBalances(sortByExpiry(otherBalances, 1), remainingQty);
    allAllocations.push(...result2.allocated);
    remainingQty = result2.remainingQty;
  }

  return { allocated: allAllocations, remainingQty };
};

// STRATEGY REGISTRY
const STRATEGIES = {
  RANDOM: sortAndAllocate((b) => sortByExpiry(b, 1)),
  "FIXED BIN": strategyFixedBin,
  FEFO: sortAndAllocate((b) => sortByExpiry(b, 1)),
  FIFO: sortAndAllocate((b) => sortByCreateTime(b, 1)),
  LIFO: sortAndAllocate((b) => sortByCreateTime(b, -1)),
  LEFO: sortAndAllocate((b) => sortByExpiry(b, -1)),
  "LARGEST QTY": sortAndAllocate((b) => sortByQty(b, -1)),
  "SMALLEST QTY": sortAndAllocate((b) => sortByQty(b, 1)),
  "CLEAR BIN": (availableBalances, requestedQty) => {
    return allocateFromBalances(sortByClearBin(availableBalances, requestedQty), requestedQty);
  },
};

// Strategy-aware sort (sort only, no allocation) for whole-HU policies.
// Mirrors STRATEGIES ordering so whole-HU picks honor allocationStrategy.
const sortByStrategy = (balanceArray, strategy, requestedQty) => {
  switch (strategy) {
    case "FIFO":
      return sortByCreateTime(balanceArray, 1);
    case "LIFO":
      return sortByCreateTime(balanceArray, -1);
    case "LEFO":
      return sortByExpiry(balanceArray, -1);
    case "LARGEST QTY":
      return sortByQty(balanceArray, -1);
    case "SMALLEST QTY":
      return sortByQty(balanceArray, 1);
    case "CLEAR BIN":
      return sortByClearBin(balanceArray, requestedQty);
    case "FIXED BIN": {
      const defaultBin = getDefaultBin();
      if (!defaultBin) return sortByExpiry(balanceArray, 1);
      const inBin = sortByExpiry(
        balanceArray.filter((b) => b.location_id === defaultBin),
        1
      );
      const outBin = sortByExpiry(
        balanceArray.filter((b) => b.location_id !== defaultBin),
        1
      );
      return [...inBin, ...outBin];
    }
    case "RANDOM":
    case "FEFO":
    default:
      return sortByExpiry(balanceArray, 1);
  }
};

// MAIN EXECUTION

const existingAllocationMap = buildExistingAllocationMap(existingAllocationData);

const adjustedBalances = adjustBalancesForExisting(
  balanceData,
  existingAllocationMap
);

const availableBalances = filterAvailableBalances(adjustedBalances);

const totalAvailable = availableBalances.reduce(
  (sum, b) => sum + (b.unrestricted_qty || 0),
  0
);

// Enforce strict insufficient stock check when required
const shouldEnforceStock =
  allocationType === "MR" ||
  (enforceStockCheck === 1 && itemData.stock_control !== 0);

if (shouldEnforceStock && totalAvailable < baseQuantity) {
  return {
    code: "400",
    message: `Insufficient stock for item ${itemData.material_code || material_id}. Available: ${totalAvailable}, Requested: ${baseQuantity}`,
    allocationData: [],
    totalAllocated: 0,
  };
}

let allAllocations = [];
let remainingQty = baseQuantity;

// Step 1: If isPending, allocate from pending data first
if (isPending === 1 && pendingData.length > 0) {
  const pendingResult = allocateFromPending(pendingData, availableBalances, remainingQty);
  allAllocations.push(...pendingResult.allocated);
  remainingQty = pendingResult.remainingQty;
}

// Step 2: Apply strategy for remaining quantity
if (remainingQty > 0) {
  const remainingBalances = filterAvailableBalances(availableBalances);
  const strategyFn = STRATEGIES[allocationStrategy] || STRATEGIES["RANDOM"];

  // Separate HU and loose balances for priority-based allocation
  const huBalances = remainingBalances.filter((b) => b.source === "hu");
  const looseBalances = remainingBalances.filter((b) => b.source !== "hu");

  if (splitPolicy === "FULL_HU_PICK" && huBalances.length > 0) {
    // FULL_HU_PICK: take full qty from each HU, excess allowed
    const sortedHu = sortByStrategy(huBalances, allocationStrategy, remainingQty);
    const huResult = allocateWholeHU(sortedHu, remainingQty);
    allAllocations.push(...huResult.allocated);
    remainingQty = huResult.remainingQty;

    // Fall back to loose stock for remaining (partial allowed for loose)
    if (remainingQty > 0) {
      const looseStrategyFn = STRATEGIES[allocationStrategy] || STRATEGIES["RANDOM"];
      const looseResult = looseStrategyFn(looseBalances, remainingQty);

      for (const strategyAlloc of looseResult.allocated) {
        const key = generateKey(strategyAlloc.location_id, strategyAlloc.batch_id, strategyAlloc.handling_unit_id);
        const existingIdx = allAllocations.findIndex((a) =>
          generateKey(a.location_id, a.batch_id, a.handling_unit_id) === key
        );
        if (existingIdx >= 0) {
          allAllocations[existingIdx][qtyField] += strategyAlloc[qtyField];
        } else {
          allAllocations.push(strategyAlloc);
        }
      }
      remainingQty = looseResult.remainingQty;
    }
  } else if (splitPolicy === "NO_SPLIT" && huBalances.length > 0) {
    // NO_SPLIT: take whole HUs but only if they fit within remaining need (no over-pick)
    const sortedHu = sortByStrategy(huBalances, allocationStrategy, remainingQty);
    const huResult = allocateWholeHUWithLimit(sortedHu, remainingQty);
    allAllocations.push(...huResult.allocated);
    remainingQty = huResult.remainingQty;

    // Fall back to loose stock for remaining
    if (remainingQty > 0) {
      const looseStrategyFn = STRATEGIES[allocationStrategy] || STRATEGIES["RANDOM"];
      const looseResult = looseStrategyFn(looseBalances, remainingQty);

      for (const strategyAlloc of looseResult.allocated) {
        const key = generateKey(strategyAlloc.location_id, strategyAlloc.batch_id, strategyAlloc.handling_unit_id);
        const existingIdx = allAllocations.findIndex((a) =>
          generateKey(a.location_id, a.batch_id, a.handling_unit_id) === key
        );
        if (existingIdx >= 0) {
          allAllocations[existingIdx][qtyField] += strategyAlloc[qtyField];
        } else {
          allAllocations.push(strategyAlloc);
        }
      }
      remainingQty = looseResult.remainingQty;
    }
  } else {
    // ALLOW_SPLIT: existing priority-based allocation logic
    let strategyResult;

    // Determine allocation order based on HU priority
    const hasPriority =
      (huPriority === "HU First" && huBalances.length > 0) ||
      (huPriority === "Loose First" && looseBalances.length > 0);

    if (hasPriority) {
      // Allocate from primary group first, then secondary for remainder
      const primaryBalances = huPriority === "HU First" ? huBalances : looseBalances;
      const secondaryBalances = huPriority === "HU First" ? looseBalances : huBalances;

      const primaryResult = strategyFn(primaryBalances, remainingQty);
      allAllocations.push(...primaryResult.allocated);
      remainingQty = primaryResult.remainingQty;

      if (remainingQty > 0) {
        strategyResult = strategyFn(secondaryBalances, remainingQty);
      } else {
        strategyResult = { allocated: [], remainingQty: 0 };
      }
    } else {
      // "Strategy" mode or no HU: pure strategy sorting across all
      strategyResult = strategyFn(remainingBalances, remainingQty);
    }

    // Merge strategy allocations with pending allocations
    for (const strategyAlloc of strategyResult.allocated) {
      const key = generateKey(strategyAlloc.location_id, strategyAlloc.batch_id, strategyAlloc.handling_unit_id);
      const existingIdx = allAllocations.findIndex((a) => {
        return generateKey(a.location_id, a.batch_id, a.handling_unit_id) === key;
      });

      if (existingIdx >= 0) {
        allAllocations[existingIdx][qtyField] += strategyAlloc[qtyField];
      } else {
        allAllocations.push(strategyAlloc);
      }
    }

    remainingQty = strategyResult.remainingQty;
  }
}

const totalAllocated = allAllocations.reduce(
  (sum, a) => sum + (a[qtyField] || 0),
  0
);

// Enforce strict post-allocation check
if (shouldEnforceStock && totalAllocated < baseQuantity) {
  return {
    code: "400",
    message: `Insufficient stock for item ${itemData.material_code || material_id}. Available: ${totalAllocated}, Requested: ${baseQuantity}`,
    allocationData: [],
    totalAllocated: 0,
  };
}

// Convert allocated quantities back from base UOM to order UOM for the consumer
if (conversionFactor !== 1) {
  const reverseFactor = 1 / conversionFactor;
  for (const alloc of allAllocations) {
    alloc[qtyField] = q8(alloc[qtyField] * reverseFactor);
  }
}

const totalAllocatedFinal = allAllocations.reduce(
  (sum, a) => sum + (a[qtyField] || 0),
  0
);

return {
  code: totalAllocated >= baseQuantity ? "200" : "206",
  message:
    totalAllocated >= baseQuantity
      ? "Allocation successful"
      : `Partial allocation. Available: ${totalAllocated}, Requested: ${baseQuantity}`,
  allocationData: allAllocations,
  totalAllocated: totalAllocatedFinal,
};

}
function gaItemNorm(Q) {
// Rebuilds exactly the shape the old "Get Item" get-node handed downstream, so
// every comparison further down keeps behaving identically: bigint ids stay
// strings (CAST AS CHAR), int flags stay numbers, and the two JSON_ARRAYAGG
// columns become arrays again. The get-node was a 10-way LEFT JOIN over every
// Item subform -- ~150k rows to read five fields.
const rowsRaw = Q.rows || [];
const rows = Array.isArray(rowsRaw) ? rowsRaw : [rowsRaw];
const row = rows.find((r) => r && r.id) || null;

const asNum = (v) =>
  v === null || v === undefined || v === "" ? null : Number(v);
const asArray = (v) => {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v;
  try {
    const parsed = v ? JSON.parse(v) : [];
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
};

const itemData = row
  ? {
      id: String(row.id),
      material_code: row.material_code || "",
      item_batch_management: asNum(row.item_batch_management),
      stock_control: asNum(row.stock_control),
      table_uom_conversion: asArray(row.uom_conversion_json),
      table_default_bin: asArray(row.default_bin_json),
    }
  : null;

return {
  itemFound: row ? 1 : 0,
  isBatchManaged: itemData && itemData.item_batch_management === 1 ? 1 : 0,
  itemData: itemData,
};

}
function gaPrepare(Q) {
const allData = Q.allData;
const tableGd = allData.table_gd || [];
const itemDataRaw = Q.itemFlags || [];

// Normalize Get Items output (may be single object when count=1) and build flags lookup
const itemDataArray = Array.isArray(itemDataRaw) ? itemDataRaw : [itemDataRaw];
// The sql-node may hand these back as strings; null must stay non-matching.
const asFlag = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" ? null : Number(v));
const itemFlagsMap = {};
for (const it of itemDataArray) {
  if (it && it.id) {
    itemFlagsMap[it.id] = {
      stock_control: asFlag(it.stock_control),
      show_delivery: asFlag(it.show_delivery)
    };
  }
}

// Filter rows that need allocation:
// - gd_qty > 0
// - no existing allocation (temp_qty_data)
// - has material_id
// - not a description-only row (stock_control=0 AND show_delivery=0)

// A bundle is ONE row of table_gd with the bundle's items under `children`. The
// bundle row owns no stock, so allocation steps over it; its items are allocated
// like any other line. Rows are numbered by their position in this flat walk --
// the same numbering the allocation tracker and the cross-line distribution use,
// so all three agree on what "line 3" means.
const flattenGdRows = (rows) =>
  (rows || []).flatMap((row) => [
    row,
    ...(Array.isArray(row.children) ? row.children : []),
  ]);

// parentIndex/childIndex is the address that writes the result back into the
// tree; childIndex is null on a top-level row.
const rowsNeedingAllocation = [];
const flatRows = [];

tableGd.forEach((row, parentIndex) => {
  flatRows.push({ row: row, parentIndex: parentIndex, childIndex: null });

  (Array.isArray(row.children) ? row.children : []).forEach((child, childIndex) => {
    flatRows.push({ row: child, parentIndex: parentIndex, childIndex: childIndex });
  });
});

flatRows.forEach((entry, index) => {
  const row = entry.row;
  const gdQty = parseFloat(row.gd_qty) || 0;
  const hasTempData = row.temp_qty_data && 
                      row.temp_qty_data !== "[]" && 
                      row.temp_qty_data.trim() !== "";
  
  if (gdQty <= 0 || hasTempData || !row.material_id) return;
  
  const flags = itemFlagsMap[row.material_id];
  if (flags && flags.stock_control === 0 && flags.show_delivery === 0) {
    return;
  }
  
  rowsNeedingAllocation.push({
    rowIndex: index,
    parentIndex: entry.parentIndex,
    childIndex: entry.childIndex,
    materialId: row.material_id,
    quantity: gdQty,
    uomId: row.gd_order_uom_id,
    plantId: allData.plant_id,
    organizationId: allData.organization_id,
    soLineItemId: row.so_line_item_id || null
  });
});

// Initialize allocation tracker for cross-row deduplication
const allocationTracker = {};

return {
  rowsNeedingAllocation,
  allocationTracker,
  plantId: allData.plant_id,
  organizationId: allData.organization_id,
  totalRowsToAllocate: rowsNeedingAllocation.length
};

}
function gaParams(Q) {
// Global Allocation Params (code_node_Htpcyp8t)
// This is the code for the backend workflow node that prepares params for GLOBAL_AUTO_ALLOCATION.
// Copy this into the platform's code node editor.
// CHANGES: Added splitPolicy, lineMaterials to the return object.
//          For FULL_HU_PICK/NO_SPLIT, includes ALL items per HU (not just current material).

const currentRow = Q.currentRow;
// Resolved setup, NOT the raw fetch: the raw row is null when the org has no
// picking setup, which used to throw on pickingSetup.split_policy below.
const pickingSetup = Q.effectiveSetup || {};
const rawTracker = Q.rawTracker;
const allData = Q.allData;
const allHUData = Q.allHUData || [];
const isGDPP = allData.is_select_picking || 0;
const gd_status = Q.allData.gd_status || "Draft";
const rowsNeedingAllocation = Q.rowsNeedingAllocation;

// Split policy from picking setup
const splitPolicy = pickingSetup.split_policy || "ALLOW_SPLIT";
const allowMixedItem = pickingSetup.allow_mixed_item ?? 1;

let allocationTracker = {};
if (rawTracker) {
  if (typeof rawTracker === "string") {
    try {
      allocationTracker = JSON.parse(rawTracker);
    } catch (e) {
      allocationTracker = {};
    }
  } else if (typeof rawTracker === "object") {
    allocationTracker = rawTracker;
  }
}

// Build existingAllocationData from tracker (cross-row deduction)
const existingAllocations = [];
const materialAllocations = allocationTracker[currentRow.materialId] || {};

Object.entries(materialAllocations).forEach(([rIdx, rowAllocs]) => {
  if (parseInt(rIdx) !== currentRow.rowIndex) {
    Object.entries(rowAllocs).forEach(([locationKey, qty]) => {
      const parts = locationKey.split("-");
      const locationId = parts[0];
      let batchId = null;
      let handlingUnitId = null;

      if (parts.length > 1) {
        if (parts[1] === "hu") {
          handlingUnitId = parts[2] || null;
        } else {
          batchId = parts[1] !== "no_batch" ? parts[1] : null;
        }
      }

      existingAllocations.push({
        location_id: locationId,
        batch_id: batchId,
        handling_unit_id: handlingUnitId,
        quantity: qty,
      });
    });
  }
});

// Build HU data from pre-fetched allHUData
const huData = [];
for (const hu of allHUData) {
  // For ALLOW_SPLIT: only include items matching current material
  // For FULL_HU_PICK/NO_SPLIT: include ALL items in HUs that contain current material
  const allActiveItems = (hu.table_hu_items || []).filter(
    (item) => item.is_deleted !== 1,
  );
  const hasCurrentMaterial = allActiveItems.some(
    (item) => item.material_id === currentRow.materialId,
  );
  if (!hasCurrentMaterial) continue;

  // Skip packed HUs (committed to a Packing doc). Their qty lives in
  // reserved_qty, not unrestricted, so they must not be injected as
  // allocatable stock. Mirrors the dialog fetchHandlingUnits skip.
  if (hu.packing_id) continue;

  const itemsToInclude = splitPolicy === "ALLOW_SPLIT"
    ? allActiveItems.filter((item) => item.material_id === currentRow.materialId)
    : allActiveItems;

  // Header row
  huData.push({
    row_type: "header",
    handling_unit_id: hu.id,
    handling_no: hu.handling_no,
    material_id: "",
    material_name: "",
    storage_location_id: hu.storage_location_id,
    location_id: hu.location_id,
    batch_id: null,
    item_quantity: parseFloat(hu.total_quantity) || 0,
    deliver_quantity: 0,
    remark: hu.remark || "",
    balance_id: "",
  });

  // Item rows
  for (const huItem of itemsToInclude) {
    huData.push({
      row_type: "item",
      handling_unit_id: hu.id,
      handling_no: "",
      material_id: huItem.material_id,
      material_name: huItem.material_name,
      storage_location_id: hu.storage_location_id,
      location_id: huItem.location_id || hu.location_id,
      batch_id: huItem.batch_id || null,
      item_quantity: parseFloat(huItem.quantity) || 0,
      deliver_quantity: 0,
      remark: "",
      balance_id: huItem.balance_id || "",
      expired_date: huItem.expired_date || null,
      manufacturing_date: huItem.manufacturing_date || null,
      create_time: huItem.create_time || hu.create_time,
    });
  }
}

return {
  material_id: currentRow.materialId,
  quantity: currentRow.quantity,
  plant_id: currentRow.plantId,
  organization_id: currentRow.organizationId,
  allocationType: "GD",
  allocationStrategy: pickingSetup.default_strategy_id || "RANDOM",
  isPending: currentRow.soLineItemId ? 1 : 0,
  parent_line_id: currentRow.soLineItemId || "",
  existingAllocationData: existingAllocations,
  huData: huData,
  huPriority: pickingSetup.hu_priority || "Loose First",
  currentDocId: allData.id || "",
  enforceStockCheck: 1,
  includeReservedQty: (gd_status === "Created" || isGDPP === 1) ? 1 : 0,
  orderUomId: currentRow.uomId || "",
  splitPolicy: splitPolicy,
  allowMixedItem: allowMixedItem,
  lineMaterials: rowsNeedingAllocation.map((r) => r.materialId),
};

}
function gaResult(Q) {
// processAllocationResult - Maps global workflow result to GD row data
// Replaces the result-building part of executeAllocation
// ============================================================================

const currentRow = Q.currentRow;
const workflowResult = Q.workflowResult;
const allUOMs = Q.allUOMs || [];
const allBinLocations = Q.allBinLocations || [];
const rawTracker = Q.rawTracker;
const huData = Q.huData || [];
const splitPolicy = Q.splitPolicy || "ALLOW_SPLIT";
const batchMasterData = Q.batchMasterData || [];

let allocationTracker = {};
if (rawTracker) {
  if (typeof rawTracker === "string") {
    try {
      allocationTracker = JSON.parse(rawTracker);
    } catch (e) {
      allocationTracker = {};
    }
  } else if (typeof rawTracker === "object") {
    allocationTracker = rawTracker;
  }
}

// Extract allocation result from workflow response
const allocationResult = workflowResult?.data || workflowResult || {};
const allocationData = allocationResult.allocationData || [];

// For whole-HU policies, allocations may include items for other materials
const currentMaterialAllocs = allocationData.filter(
  (a) => !a.material_id || a.material_id === currentRow.materialId,
);
const otherMaterialAllocs = splitPolicy !== "ALLOW_SPLIT"
  ? allocationData.filter(
      (a) => a.material_id && a.material_id !== currentRow.materialId,
    )
  : [];

// Helper: lookup bin location name
const getBinLocationName = (locationId) => {
  const bin = allBinLocations.find((b) => b.id === locationId);
  return bin ? bin.bin_location_combine : locationId;
};

// Helper: lookup UOM name
const getUOMName = (uomId) => {
  const uom = allUOMs.find((u) => u.id === uomId);
  return uom ? uom.uom_name : "";
};

// Helper: lookup handling_no from huData header rows
const getHandlingNo = (handlingUnitId) => {
  const header = huData.find(
    (row) => row.row_type === "header" && row.handling_unit_id === handlingUnitId,
  );
  return header ? header.handling_no : handlingUnitId;
};

// Helper: lookup batch_number from batchMasterData
const getBatchNumber = (batchId) => {
  if (!batchId) return "";
  const b = batchMasterData.find((m) => m.id === batchId);
  return b?.batch_number || batchId;
};

// Separate HU and loose allocations (current material only)
const looseAllocations = currentMaterialAllocs.filter((a) => a.source !== "hu");
const huAllocations = currentMaterialAllocs.filter((a) => a.source === "hu");

// Build temp_qty_data (loose + HU combined, same shape as before)
const tempQtyData = currentMaterialAllocs.map((alloc) => {
  const record = {
    material_id: currentRow.materialId,
    location_id: alloc.location_id,
    batch_id: alloc.batch_id || null,
    unrestricted_qty:
      alloc.original_unrestricted_qty || alloc.unrestricted_qty,
    plant_id: currentRow.plantId,
    organization_id: currentRow.organizationId,
    is_deleted: 0,
    gd_quantity: alloc.gd_quantity || 0,
    balance_id: alloc.balance_id || "",
  };

  // Tag HU records so they can be distinguished later
  if (alloc.source === "hu" && alloc.handling_unit_id) {
    record.handling_unit_id = alloc.handling_unit_id;
  }

  return record;
});

// Build temp_hu_data (HU-only allocations for HU-specific processing)
const tempHuData = huAllocations.map((alloc) => ({
  row_type: "item",
  handling_unit_id: alloc.handling_unit_id,
  handling_no: getHandlingNo(alloc.handling_unit_id),
  material_id: alloc.material_id || currentRow.materialId,
  location_id: alloc.location_id,
  batch_id: alloc.batch_id || null,
  balance_id: alloc.balance_id || "",
  deliver_quantity: alloc.gd_quantity || 0,
  item_quantity: alloc.original_unrestricted_qty || alloc.unrestricted_qty || 0,
}));

// Build view_stock summary
const uomName = getUOMName(currentRow.uomId);
const totalAllocated = currentMaterialAllocs.reduce(
  (sum, a) => sum + (a.gd_quantity || 0),
  0,
);

let viewStock = "";

if (totalAllocated > 0) {
  const looseTotal = looseAllocations.reduce(
    (sum, a) => sum + (a.gd_quantity || 0),
    0,
  );
  const huTotal = huAllocations.reduce(
    (sum, a) => sum + (a.gd_quantity || 0),
    0,
  );

  viewStock = `Total: ${totalAllocated} ${uomName}\n\n`;

  if (huAllocations.length > 0 && looseAllocations.length > 0) {
    // Both loose and HU
    viewStock += `LOOSE STOCK:\n`;
    looseAllocations.forEach((alloc, idx) => {
      const binName = getBinLocationName(alloc.location_id);
      let line = `${idx + 1}. ${binName}: ${alloc.gd_quantity} ${uomName}`;
      if (alloc.batch_id) {
        line += `\n[Batch: ${getBatchNumber(alloc.batch_id)}]`;
      }
      viewStock += line + "\n";
    });

    viewStock += `\nHANDLING UNIT:\n`;
    huAllocations.forEach((alloc, idx) => {
      const binName = getBinLocationName(alloc.location_id);
      let line = `${idx + 1}. ${binName}: ${alloc.gd_quantity} ${uomName}`;
      if (alloc.handling_unit_id) {
        line += ` [HU: ${getHandlingNo(alloc.handling_unit_id)}]`;
      }
      if (alloc.batch_id) {
        line += `\n[Batch: ${getBatchNumber(alloc.batch_id)}]`;
      }
      viewStock += line + "\n";
    });
  } else if (huAllocations.length > 0) {
    // HU only
    viewStock += `HANDLING UNIT:\n`;
    huAllocations.forEach((alloc, idx) => {
      const binName = getBinLocationName(alloc.location_id);
      let line = `${idx + 1}. ${binName}: ${alloc.gd_quantity} ${uomName}`;
      if (alloc.handling_unit_id) {
        line += ` [HU: ${getHandlingNo(alloc.handling_unit_id)}]`;
      }
      if (alloc.batch_id) {
        line += `\n[Batch: ${getBatchNumber(alloc.batch_id)}]`;
      }
      viewStock += line + "\n";
    });
  } else {
    // Loose only
    viewStock += `DETAILS:\n`;
    looseAllocations.forEach((alloc, idx) => {
      const binName = getBinLocationName(alloc.location_id);
      let line = `${idx + 1}. ${binName}: ${alloc.gd_quantity} ${uomName}`;
      if (alloc.batch_id) {
        line += `\n[Batch: ${getBatchNumber(alloc.batch_id)}]`;
      }
      viewStock += line + "\n";
    });
  }
}

// Cross-line distribution for whole-HU policies
const crossLineUpdates = {};
const tempExcessData = [];

if (splitPolicy !== "ALLOW_SPLIT" && otherMaterialAllocs.length > 0) {
  const rawTableGD = Q.rawTableGD;
  let tableGD = [];
  if (rawTableGD) {
    tableGD = typeof rawTableGD === "string" ? JSON.parse(rawTableGD) : rawTableGD;
  }


// A bundle is ONE row of table_gd with the bundle's items under `children`. The
// bundle row owns no stock, so allocation steps over it; its items are allocated
// like any other line. Rows are numbered by their position in this flat walk --
// the same numbering the allocation tracker and the cross-line distribution use,
// so all three agree on what "line 3" means.
const flattenGdRows = (rows) =>
  (rows || []).flatMap((row) => [
    row,
    ...(Array.isArray(row.children) ? row.children : []),
  ]);

  // Build material -> line indices map
  const materialLineMap = {};
  flattenGdRows(tableGD).forEach((line, idx) => {
    if (idx === currentRow.rowIndex) return;
    if (line.material_id) {
      if (!materialLineMap[line.material_id]) materialLineMap[line.material_id] = [];
      materialLineMap[line.material_id].push(idx);
    }
  });

  for (const alloc of otherMaterialAllocs) {
    const targetLines = materialLineMap[alloc.material_id];

    if (!targetLines || targetLines.length === 0) {
      // Foreign item — no matching GD line
      tempExcessData.push({
        handling_unit_id: alloc.handling_unit_id || "",
        handling_no: getHandlingNo(alloc.handling_unit_id),
        material_id: alloc.material_id,
        material_name: alloc.material_name || "",
        quantity: alloc.gd_quantity || 0,
        batch_id: alloc.batch_id || null,
        location_id: alloc.location_id,
        reason: "no_gd_line",
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Distribute to first matching line
    const targetIdx = targetLines[0];
    if (!crossLineUpdates[targetIdx]) {
      crossLineUpdates[targetIdx] = { tempQtyData: [], tempHuData: [] };
    }

    crossLineUpdates[targetIdx].tempQtyData.push({
      material_id: alloc.material_id,
      location_id: alloc.location_id,
      batch_id: alloc.batch_id || null,
      unrestricted_qty: alloc.original_unrestricted_qty || alloc.unrestricted_qty,
      plant_id: currentRow.plantId,
      organization_id: currentRow.organizationId,
      is_deleted: 0,
      gd_quantity: alloc.gd_quantity || 0,
      balance_id: alloc.balance_id || "",
      handling_unit_id: alloc.handling_unit_id || "",
    });

    if (alloc.source === "hu") {
      crossLineUpdates[targetIdx].tempHuData.push({
        row_type: "item",
        handling_unit_id: alloc.handling_unit_id,
        handling_no: getHandlingNo(alloc.handling_unit_id),
        material_id: alloc.material_id,
        location_id: alloc.location_id,
        batch_id: alloc.batch_id || null,
        balance_id: alloc.balance_id || "",
        deliver_quantity: alloc.gd_quantity || 0,
        item_quantity: alloc.original_unrestricted_qty || alloc.unrestricted_qty || 0,
      });
    }
  }
}

// Check for over-pick excess on current material
const currentMaterialTotal = currentMaterialAllocs.reduce(
  (sum, a) => sum + (a.gd_quantity || 0), 0,
);
if (currentMaterialTotal > currentRow.quantity && currentRow.quantity > 0) {
  tempExcessData.push({
    handling_unit_id: currentMaterialAllocs.find((a) => a.handling_unit_id)?.handling_unit_id || "",
    handling_no: "",
    material_id: currentRow.materialId,
    material_name: "",
    quantity: currentMaterialTotal - currentRow.quantity,
    batch_id: null,
    location_id: "",
    reason: "over_pick",
  });
}

// Update allocation tracker for cross-row deduction
const updatedTracker = { ...allocationTracker };
if (!updatedTracker[currentRow.materialId]) {
  updatedTracker[currentRow.materialId] = {};
}

const rowAllocations = {};
currentMaterialAllocs.forEach((alloc) => {
  // Only track loose allocations for cross-row deduction
  // HU stock is independent and already deducted from balances
  if (alloc.source === "hu") return;

  const key = alloc.batch_id
    ? `${alloc.location_id}-${alloc.batch_id}`
    : `${alloc.location_id}`;
  rowAllocations[key] = (rowAllocations[key] || 0) + (alloc.gd_quantity || 0);
});
updatedTracker[currentRow.materialId][currentRow.rowIndex] = rowAllocations;

return {
  temp_qty_data: JSON.stringify(tempQtyData),
  temp_hu_data: JSON.stringify(tempHuData),
  temp_excess_data: JSON.stringify(tempExcessData || []),
  view_stock: viewStock,
  total_allocated: totalAllocated,
  rowIndex: currentRow.rowIndex,
  updatedTracker: updatedTracker,
  crossLineUpdates: crossLineUpdates,
};

}
function gaUpdateRow(Q) {
// updateRowInTableGd (code_node_56IOJIBu)
// Updated to handle crossLineUpdates and temp_excess_data from split policy.
// Copy this into the platform's code node editor.

const rawtableGD = Q.rawTableGD;
let tableGD = [];

if (rawtableGD) {
  if (typeof rawtableGD === "string") {
    tableGD = JSON.parse(rawtableGD);
  } else {
    tableGD = rawtableGD;
  }
}

const allocationResult = Q.allocationResult;
const rowIndex = allocationResult.rowIndex;

// A bundle is ONE row of table_gd with the bundle's items under `children`. The
// bundle row owns no stock, so allocation steps over it; its items are allocated
// like any other line. Rows are numbered by their position in this flat walk --
// the same numbering the allocation tracker and the cross-line distribution use,
// so all three agree on what "line 3" means.
const flattenGdRows = (rows) =>
  (rows || []).flatMap((row) => [
    row,
    ...(Array.isArray(row.children) ? row.children : []),
  ]);

// The flat view holds the very same row objects the tree does, so writing
// through it updates the tree in place and tableGD goes back out unchanged in
// shape.
const flatGD = flattenGdRows(tableGD);

// Update current row
if (flatGD[rowIndex]) {
  const target = flatGD[rowIndex];

  target.temp_qty_data = allocationResult.temp_qty_data;
  target.temp_hu_data = allocationResult.temp_hu_data;
  target.view_stock = allocationResult.view_stock;

  // Save temp_excess_data on current row
  if (allocationResult.temp_excess_data) {
    target.temp_excess_data = allocationResult.temp_excess_data;
  }

  const gdQty = parseFloat(target.gd_qty) || 0;
  const initialDeliveredQty =
    parseFloat(target.gd_initial_delivered_qty) || 0;
  const orderedQty = parseFloat(target.gd_order_quantity) || 0;

  target.gd_delivered_qty = initialDeliveredQty + gdQty;
  target.gd_undelivered_qty =
    Math.max(0, orderedQty - (initialDeliveredQty + gdQty));
}

// Apply cross-line distribution updates from whole-HU policies
const crossLineUpdates = allocationResult.crossLineUpdates || {};
for (const [idx, updates] of Object.entries(crossLineUpdates)) {
  const lineIdx = parseInt(idx);
  if (!flatGD[lineIdx]) continue;

  // Merge with existing temp data on the target line
  let existingQty = [];
  let existingHu = [];
  const crossTarget = flatGD[lineIdx];

  try {
    if (crossTarget.temp_qty_data && crossTarget.temp_qty_data !== "[]") {
      existingQty = JSON.parse(crossTarget.temp_qty_data);
    }
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  try {
    if (crossTarget.temp_hu_data && crossTarget.temp_hu_data !== "[]") {
      existingHu = JSON.parse(crossTarget.temp_hu_data);
    }
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  crossTarget.temp_qty_data = JSON.stringify([...existingQty, ...updates.tempQtyData]);
  crossTarget.temp_hu_data = JSON.stringify([...existingHu, ...updates.tempHuData]);
}

return {
  tableGD: tableGD,
  updatedTracker: allocationResult.updatedTracker,
};

}
const prepareAutoAllocate = function prepareAutoAllocate(guard, parse, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const ID = /^[0-9]{1,19}$/;
  const J = (v) => (v === undefined ? undefined : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v))); // what one node hands the next: JSON
  const facts = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind));
  const kind = (k) => facts.filter((r) => s(r.kind) === k);
  const lines = Array.isArray(parse.lines) ? parse.lines : [];
  const idLists = (ls) => {
    const loc = {};
    const tup = {};
    for (const l of ls) for (const a of l.allocations || []) {
      if (ID.test(s(a.location_id))) loc[s(a.location_id)] = true;
      if (ID.test(s(a.location_id)) && ID.test(s(l.material_id))) tup[s(l.material_id) + "," + s(a.location_id)] = true;
    }
    const lk = Object.keys(loc).sort();
    const tk = Object.keys(tup).sort();
    return { locationIdsSql: lk.length ? lk.join(",") : "0", tuplesSql: tk.length ? tk.map((t) => "(" + t + ")").join(",") : "(0,0)" };
  };
  // the old save's picking gate of a Created line (code_picking_defaults: gdSetup = the organization's first
  // picking_setup row only when picking_after is "Goods Delivery"; pickingRequired = its picking_required = 1): read
  // here from the same SETUP row, whatever the auto allocation does - Validate stamps an item bundle row with it
  const st0 = kind("SETUP")[0];
  // review fix round 1, M-1: the old save turns picking off for an internal-trading delivery (code_gr_gate skipPicking:
  // a Linked sales order, an active Internal Trading Setup of the first linkage's buyer / seller with auto_create_gr 1
  // and skip_picking 1 -> code_node_IyJHrBst line 10 pickingSetup.picking_required = 0), whatever saveAs is
  const idOrder = (a, b) => (s(a.id).length - s(b.id).length) || (s(a.id) < s(b.id) ? -1 : s(a.id) > s(b.id) ? 1 : 0);
  const linkRows = kind("LINK").slice().sort(idOrder);
  const linkedSoIds = linkRows.map((r) => s(r.v1)).filter((x, i, a) => x && a.indexOf(x) === i);
  // code_gr_link: the first linkage row (id order) that names a buyer / a seller
  const buyerOrg = (linkRows.filter((r) => s(r.v2))[0] || {}).v2 || "0";
  const sellerOrg = (linkRows.filter((r) => s(r.v3))[0] || {}).v3 || "0";
  const itsRows = kind("ITS").filter((r) => s(r.v2) === s(buyerOrg) && s(r.v3) === s(sellerOrg));
  const skipPicking = linkedSoIds.length > 0 && itsRows.some((r) => s(r.q1) === "1") && itsRows.some((r) => s(r.q2) === "1") ? 1 : 0;
  const pickingRequired = st0 && s(st0.v4) === "Goods Delivery" && s(st0.q1) === "1" && !skipPicking ? 1 : 0;
  const res = Object.assign({ route: "", lines: lines, autoRows: [], autoErrors: [], autoLines: 0, autoLog: { gate: "", rows: 0, allocated: 0, refused: 0 }, pickingRequired: pickingRequired }, idLists(lines));
  if (parse.route !== "CONTINUE" || !s(parse.autoMaterialIdsSql) || s(parse.autoMaterialIdsSql) === "0") {
    res.autoLog.gate = "NO_CANDIDATE";
    res.route = "NONE";
    return res;
  }
  // ---- old save code_picking_defaults: the organization's picking setup row, or the defaults; gate IF Auto PickingMode
  const st = kind("SETUP")[0];
  const orgSetup = st ? { picking_mode: st.v1, default_strategy_id: st.v2, split_policy: st.v3 } : null;
  const effectiveSetup = orgSetup || { picking_mode: "Auto", default_strategy_id: "RANDOM", fallback_strategy_id: "FIXED BIN", split_policy: "ALLOW_SPLIT" };
  if ((effectiveSetup.picking_mode || "Manual") !== "Auto") {
    res.autoLog.gate = "PICKING_MODE_" + s(effectiveSetup.picking_mode || "Manual").toUpperCase();
    res.route = "NONE";
    return res;
  }
  res.autoLog.gate = "AUTO";
  // ---- the form's data as the old save receives it (a new delivery: no id; temp_qty_data as text). Item bundles: the
  // lines are FLAT (gdPayloadShape: a bundle row, its items, the next row) and so is this table - no row keeps its
  // `children` - so the lifted nodes number the rows by the old save's own flat walk (code_node_kJx9p9Nh: the bundle
  // row has no material and is never allocated, each item is) and lineAt[rowIndex] / tableGD[i] address the same line
  const header = parse.header || {};
  const tableGd0 = lines.map((l) => {
    const r = Object.assign({}, l.raw || {}, { temp_qty_data: l.allocations && l.allocations.length ? JSON.stringify((l.raw || {}).temp_qty_data) : "[]" });
    delete r.children;
    return r;
  });
  const allData = { id: "", plant_id: parse.plantId, organization_id: parse.organizationId, gd_status: header.gd_status, is_select_picking: header.is_select_picking, table_gd: tableGd0 };
  // ---- facts by material
  const items = {};
  for (const r of kind("ITEM")) items[s(r.id)] = r;
  const count = {};
  for (const r of kind("CNT")) count[s(r.v1) + "|" + s(r.material_id)] = Number(r.n) || 0;
  const hu = {};
  for (const r of kind("HU")) hu[s(r.material_id)] = Number(r.n) || 0;
  const huRes = {};
  for (const r of kind("HURES")) huRes[s(r.material_id)] = Number(r.n) || 0;
  const pend = {};
  for (const r of kind("PEND")) pend[s(r.v1)] = Number(r.n) || 0;
  // a search-node row: ids as text, quantities as numbers, a NULL field absent
  const balRow = (r, batch) => {
    const o = { id: s(r.id), material_id: s(r.material_id), location_id: s(r.location_id), plant_id: s(parse.plantId), organization_id: s(parse.organizationId), unrestricted_qty: parseFloat(r.q1) || 0, reserved_qty: parseFloat(r.q2) || 0, balance_quantity: parseFloat(r.q3) || 0, create_time: s(r.t1) };
    if (batch) o.batch_id = s(r.batch_id);
    if (s(r.t2)) o.expired_date = s(r.t2);
    if (s(r.t3)) o.manufacturing_date = s(r.t3);
    return o;
  };
  const balances = { item: {}, batch: {} };
  for (const r of kind("IBAL")) (balances.item[s(r.material_id)] = balances.item[s(r.material_id)] || []).push(balRow(r, false));
  for (const r of kind("BBAL")) (balances.batch[s(r.material_id)] = balances.batch[s(r.material_id)] || []).push(balRow(r, true));
  // the search order (id ascending): sorting ties keep it (a UNION returns its rows in no set order)
  const byId = (a, b) => (a.id.length - b.id.length) || (a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0);
  for (const t of ["item", "batch"]) for (const m of Object.keys(balances[t])) balances[t][m].sort(byId);
  const allUOMs = kind("UOM").map((r) => ({ id: s(r.id), uom_name: r.v1 === undefined ? null : r.v1 }));
  const allBinLocations = kind("BIN").map((r) => ({ id: s(r.id), bin_location_combine: r.v1 === undefined ? null : r.v1 }));
  const batchNo = {};
  for (const r of kind("BATCH")) batchNo[s(r.id)] = r.v1 === undefined ? null : r.v1;
  // ---- old save prepareAllocationData (Get Items: no row matches the bigint ids it compares, so it skips nothing)
  const prep = J(gaPrepare(J({ allData: allData, itemFlags: [] })));
  const all = Array.isArray(prep.rowsNeedingAllocation) ? prep.rowsNeedingAllocation : [];
  res.autoLog.rows = all.length;
  const lineAt = {};
  lines.forEach((l, i) => (lineAt[i] = l));
  const err = (line, field, code, message) => res.autoErrors.push({ line_no: line ? line.line_no : null, stable_line_key: line ? line.stable_line_key : "", allocation_sequence: null, field: field, code: code, message: message });
  // Linear in the line count (2026-10-02, no line maximum): the structures every line shares - the table, the
  // tracker, the rows needing allocation, the unit and bin names - are handed to the lifted nodes as they are, not as
  // a fresh JSON copy per line (that copy made the loop O(L^2): 13.4 s at 499 lines on dev). They are JSON already
  // (built from JSON here) and the lifted code only reads them, except: gaResult adds THIS row's entry to the tracker
  // it is given and gaUpdateRow writes THIS row's fields into the table it is given - the values the per-line copies
  // carried forward, so the result is the same; the row gaUpdateRow wrote is passed through JSON once (as a node
  // boundary would). Per-line values (the request, the allocation, the result) still go through J as before. The
  // balance rows of the item stay a per-line copy (Execute Allocation adjusts them in place; at most 500 per item).
  const flatRows = (rows) => {
    const flat = [];
    for (const r of rows || []) {
      flat.push(r);
      if (r && Array.isArray(r.children)) for (const c of r.children) flat.push(c);
    }
    return flat;
  };
  const lineMaterials = J(all.map((r) => r.materialId)); // the same list for every line (gaParams' lineMaterials)
  const nested = (allData.table_gd || []).some((r) => r && Array.isArray(r.children) && r.children.length); // rows = flat rows unless a row has children
  let tableGD = allData.table_gd;
  let tracker = {};
  const done = {};
  for (const currentRow of all) {
    const line = lineAt[currentRow.rowIndex];
    const it = items[s(currentRow.materialId)];
    // V2 refuses these lines itself (validate): no allocation is attempted for them
    if (!line || !it || s(it.v3) !== "1") continue; // ITEM row: v3 = stock_control
    if (currentRow.soLineItemId && pend[s(currentRow.soLineItemId)]) continue;
    if (hu[s(currentRow.materialId)]) {
      err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "auto allocation: handling units in this plant hold this item; the old save's allocation would consider them and handling-unit stock is not supported by the V2 path yet (choose the stock with Select Stock)");
      res.autoLog.refused++;
      continue;
    }
    // Global Allocation Params -> the GLOBAL_ALLOCATION request
    const P0 = gaParams({ currentRow: currentRow, effectiveSetup: effectiveSetup, rawTracker: tracker, allData: allData, allHUData: [], rowsNeedingAllocation: all });
    const P = J(Object.assign({}, P0, { lineMaterials: [] }));
    P.lineMaterials = lineMaterials;
    // GLOBAL_ALLOCATION: Get Item -> Normalise Item -> the balance search of its branch -> (isPending) pending + HU
    // reservation searches -> Get Own Reserved (a new delivery has no id: not read) -> Execute Allocation
    const norm = J(gaItemNorm(J({ rows: [{ id: s(it.id), material_code: it.v1, item_batch_management: it.v2 === null || it.v2 === undefined || it.v2 === "" ? null : Number(it.v2), stock_control: it.v3 === null || it.v3 === undefined || it.v3 === "" ? null : Number(it.v3), uom_conversion_json: it.j1, default_bin_json: it.j2 }] })));
    const isBatch = norm.isBatchManaged === 1;
    const capped = (n, limit) => {
      const a = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(n, limit); i++) a.push({});
      return a;
    };
    const tbl = isBatch ? "item_batch_balance" : "item_balance";
    const n = count[tbl + "|" + s(currentRow.materialId)] || 0;
    const bal = n >= 500 ? capped(500, 500) : J(balances[isBatch ? "batch" : "item"][s(currentRow.materialId)] || []);
    const N = { itemData: norm.itemData, batchBalance: isBatch ? bal : null, itemBalance: isBatch ? null : bal, huReserved: Number(P.isPending) === 1 ? capped(huRes[s(currentRow.materialId)] || 0, 1000) : null, pending: Number(P.isPending) === 1 ? [] : null, ownReserved: null };
    const ga = J(gaExecute(P, N));
    const workflowResult = { code: ga.code, message: ga.message, allocationData: ga.allocationData };
    if (String(workflowResult.code) === "400") {
      err(line, "temp_qty_data", /^Insufficient stock/.test(s(workflowResult.message)) ? "GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK" : "GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED", "auto allocation: " + s(workflowResult.message));
      res.autoLog.refused++;
      continue;
    }
    // Get Batch ID -> IF Batch -> Get Batch No (not run without a batch: the token is null)
    const bIds = (workflowResult.allocationData || []).map((a) => a.batch_id).filter((x) => x);
    const batchMasterData = bIds.length ? bIds.filter((x, i) => bIds.indexOf(x) === i && batchNo[s(x)] !== undefined).map((x) => ({ id: s(x), batch_number: batchNo[s(x)] })) : null;
    const ar = gaResult({ currentRow: currentRow, workflowResult: J(workflowResult), allUOMs: allUOMs, allBinLocations: allBinLocations, rawTracker: tracker, huData: P.huData, splitPolicy: P.splitPolicy, batchMasterData: J(batchMasterData), rawTableGD: tableGD });
    const allocationResult = J(Object.assign({}, ar, { updatedTracker: null }));
    allocationResult.updatedTracker = ar.updatedTracker;
    const upd = gaUpdateRow({ rawTableGD: tableGD, allocationResult: allocationResult });
    tableGD = upd.tableGD;
    tracker = upd.updatedTracker;
    const written = nested ? flatRows(tableGD)[currentRow.rowIndex] : (tableGD || [])[currentRow.rowIndex];
    if (written && typeof written === "object") {
      const clean = J(written);
      for (const k of Object.keys(written)) delete written[k];
      Object.assign(written, clean);
    }
    done[currentRow.rowIndex] = true;
  }
  // ---- back into the V2 lines: the allocations exactly as Select Stock would carry them
  const units = (v) => {
    const m = String(v).match(/^([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]{1,8}))?$/);
    return m ? BigInt(m[1]) * 100000000n + BigInt(((m[2] || "") + "00000000").slice(0, 8)) : null;
  };
  const fmt = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v);
    return isFinite(x) && x > 0 ? x.toFixed(8).replace(/0+$/, "").replace(/\.$/, "") : "";
  };
  res.lines = lines.map((l, i) => {
    if (!done[i]) return l;
    const row = tableGD[i] || {};
    let temp = [];
    try {
      temp = JSON.parse(row.temp_qty_data || "[]");
    } catch (e) {
      temp = [];
    }
    const allocations = (Array.isArray(temp) ? temp : []).map((a, j) => ({ allocation_sequence: j + 1, location_id: s(a.location_id), quantity: fmt(a.gd_quantity), batch_id: s(a.batch_id), hu_id: s(a.handling_unit_id) }));
    let sum = 0n;
    let bad = !allocations.length;
    for (const a of allocations) {
      const u = units(a.quantity);
      if (u === null || u <= 0n) bad = true;
      else sum += u;
    }
    if (bad || sum !== units(l.quantity)) {
      err(l, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "auto allocation: the allocated quantities (" + allocations.map((a) => a.quantity).join(" + ") + ") do not add up to gd_qty " + l.quantity);
      res.autoLog.refused++;
      return l;
    }
    // only what changed travels on (the lines themselves stay in Parse's output: one copy per script, I3); not
    // temp_qty_data: Validate writes every line's temp_qty_data from its allocations, as for a Select Stock line
    const patch = {};
    for (const k of Object.keys(row)) if (k !== "temp_qty_data" && JSON.stringify(row[k]) !== JSON.stringify((l.raw || {})[k])) patch[k] = row[k];
    res.autoRows.push({ i: i, allocations: allocations, patch: patch });
    res.autoLines++;
    res.autoLog.allocated++;
    return Object.assign({}, l, { allocations: allocations, raw: row, auto_allocated: 1 });
  });
  return Object.assign(res, idLists(res.lines), { route: res.autoErrors.length ? "REFUSED" : res.autoLines ? "ALLOCATED" : "NONE" });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data}}][0];
const parse = [{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data}}][0];
const res = prepareAutoAllocate(guard, parse, [{{node:sql_node_rCfSqwDY.data}}][0]);
console.log("prepare auto allocation", JSON.stringify({ log: res.autoLog, lines: res.autoLines, errors: res.autoErrors.length }));
return res;

RESP: ['route', 'autoRows', 'autoErrors', 'locationIdsSql', 'tuplesSql', 'autoLines', 'autoLog', 'pickingRequired']
