writes are batched in slices of 250 rows). Nothing was read or written. The intent must not be divided over several operations (open item O4)"},"REQUEST_HASH_INVALID":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"request_hash is malformed or does not match the payload"},"OPERATION_HASH_CONFLICT":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"create_or_read","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"operation_id already used with another request_hash; stored operation unchanged"},"OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"create_or_read","caller_may_retry":"SAME_OPERATION_LATER","message":"The operation exists and is not terminal; this call made no change. Re-read inventory_operation; do not call again while it is non-terminal."},"LOCK_CONFLICT":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"lock","caller_may_retry":"NEW_OPERATION_ID","message":"A balance key is owned by another operation; owned locks were released; no mutation"},"INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"revalidate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Balance re-read under lock cannot cover an OUT effect; no mutation"},"EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate / revalidate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"The effect shape is not implemented by V2 yet (effect matrix: HU effects, RESERVATION OUT, NONE costing, serial-managed materials, batch rows under an ITEM effect); nothing mutated"},"BALANCE_STATE_INVALID":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"revalidate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Balance row missing or inconsistent under lock; no mutation"},"STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"reconcile","caller_may_retry":"NEW_OPERATION_ID","message":"Operation went stale before mutation_started_at; owned locks released; no mutation"},"MUTATION_UNCERTAIN":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"mutate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Error, timeout or unknown result after mutation_started_at"},"VERIFICATION_MISMATCH":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"verify","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Stored state does not match the expected effect"},"STALE_AFTER_MUTATION_STARTED":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"reconcile","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"MUTATING or VERIFYING operation went stale"},"OPERATION_UNDER_REVIEW":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"repeat","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Repeat of an operation whose mutation started; nothing written"},"REVIEW_CLOSED":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"reconcile","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"The review was closed by an approved reconciliation: every effect is recorded VERIFIED or NOT_APPLIED from stored rows and the locks are released. The operation stays REQUIRES_REVIEW; any correction is a new operation with original_operation_id"}},"lock":{"row_states":[{"state":"FREE"},{"state":"HELD"},{"state":"ORPHAN_TOKEN"},{"state":"FREE_WITH_OWNER"},{"state":"INVARIANT_BREACH"}],"reconcile_decisions":{"NONE":"","WAIT":"","RELEASE":"","REJECT_OWNER_THEN_RELEASE":"","NEVER_AUTOMATIC":"","MANUAL_REVIEW":"","RELEASE_TOKEN":"","REJECT_LISTERS_THEN_RELEASE_TOKEN":""},"gate":{"key_prefix":"GATE|"}}};
const sha256Hex = function sha256Hex(text) {
  const s = String(text);
  const bytes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    let c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff) {
      const d = i + 1 < s.length ? s.charCodeAt(i + 1) : 0;
      if (d >= 0xdc00 && d <= 0xdfff) {
        c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (d - 0xdc00);
        i++;
      } else c = 0xfffd;
    } else if (c >= 0xdc00 && c <= 0xdfff) c = 0xfffd;
    if (c < 0x80) bytes.push(c);
    else if (c < 0x800) bytes.push(0xc0 | (c >> 6), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else if (c < 0x10000) bytes.push(0xe0 | (c >> 12), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else bytes.push(0xf0 | (c >> 18), 0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 63), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
  }
  const K = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da, 0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
  ];
  const H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
  const bitLen = bytes.length * 8;
  bytes.push(0x80);
  while (bytes.length % 64 !== 56) bytes.push(0);
  const hi = Math.floor(bitLen / 0x100000000);
  const lo = bitLen >>> 0;
  bytes.push((hi >>> 24) & 255, (hi >>> 16) & 255, (hi >>> 8) & 255, hi & 255, (lo >>> 24) & 255, (lo >>> 16) & 255, (lo >>> 8) & 255, lo & 255);
  const rotr = (x, n) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
  const W = new Array(64);
  for (let off = 0; off < bytes.length; off += 64) {
    for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) W[t] = ((bytes[off + 4 * t] << 24) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 1] << 16) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 2] << 8) | bytes[off + 4 * t + 3]) >>> 0;
    for (let t = 16; t < 64; t++) {
      const s0 = rotr(W[t - 15], 7) ^ rotr(W[t - 15], 18) ^ (W[t - 15] >>> 3);
      const s1 = rotr(W[t - 2], 17) ^ rotr(W[t - 2], 19) ^ (W[t - 2] >>> 10);
      W[t] = (W[t - 16] + s0 + W[t - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3], e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];
    for (let t = 0; t < 64; t++) {
      const S1 = rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25);
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[t] + W[t]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22);
      const mj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const t2 = (S0 + mj) >>> 0;
      h = g;
      g = f;
      f = e;
      e = (d + t1) >>> 0;
      d = c;
      c = b;
      b = a;
      a = (t1 + t2) >>> 0;
    }
    H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
    H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
    H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
    H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
    H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
    H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
    H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
    H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
  }
  return H.map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")).join("");
};
const BALANCE_TYPES = CONTRACT.request.effect_fields.find((f) => f.name === "balance_type").values;
const DIRECTIONS = CONTRACT.request.effect_fields.find((f) => f.name === "direction").values;
const RESULT_CODES = CONTRACT.result_codes;
const PRE_MUTATION = CONTRACT.operation.pre_mutation;
const MUTATION_STARTED = CONTRACT.operation.mutation_started;
const DECISIONS = Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(CONTRACT.repeat_decision.decisions.map((d) => [d, d])));
const BALANCE_KEY_RE = new RegExp(CONTRACT.request.effect_fields.find((f) => f.name === "balance_key").pattern);
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
const SCALE = 8;
const DECIMAL_RE = /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d{1,8}))?$/;
function canonicalQuantity(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "number" && typeof value !== "string") return null;
  if (typeof value === "number" && !Number.isFinite(value)) return null;
  const m = String(value).trim().match(DECIMAL_RE);
  if (!m) return null;
  const units = toUnits(m[1], m[2] || "");
  return units > 0n ? fromUnits(units) : null;
}
function toUnits(intPart, fracPart) {
  return BigInt(intPart) * 10n ** BigInt(SCALE) + BigInt((fracPart || "").padEnd(SCALE, "0") || "0");
}
function quantityUnits(canonical) {
  const [i, f = ""] = canonical.split(".");
  return toUnits(i, f);
}
function fromUnits(units) {
  const base = 10n ** BigInt(SCALE);
  const i = units / base;
  const f = (units % base).toString().padStart(SCALE, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
  return f ? `${i}.${f}` : `${i}`;
}
function isBlank(v) {
  return v === undefined || v === null || (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() === "");
}
function validateEffect(effect, index) {
  const errors = [];
  const fail = (code, field) => errors.push({ code, field, index });
  for (const f of CONTRACT.request.effect_fields) {
    const v = effect ? effect[f.name] : undefined;
    if (f.required && isBlank(v)) {
      fail(f.name === "quantity_base" ? "QUANTITY_INVALID" : "REQUEST_INVALID", f.name);
      continue;
    }
    if (isBlank(v)) continue;
    if (f.max_length && typeof v === "string" && v.length > f.max_length) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", f.name);
  }
  if (!effect) return errors;
  if (!isBlank(effect.effect_key) && !/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,64}$/.test(String(effect.effect_key))) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "effect_key");
  if (!isBlank(effect.balance_type) && !BALANCE_TYPES.includes(effect.balance_type)) fail("BALANCE_TYPE_INVALID", "balance_type");
  if (!isBlank(effect.balance_key)) {
    const bk = String(effect.balance_key);
    if (!/^(ITEM|BATCH|HU|RESERVATION)\|/.test(bk) || bk.split("|")[0] !== effect.balance_type) fail("BALANCE_TYPE_INVALID", "balance_key");
    // The lock SQL interpolates balance keys as text (SQL nodes bind nothing, F10/F22):
    // only these characters are ever accepted.
    else if (!BALANCE_KEY_RE.test(bk)) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "balance_key");
  }
  if (!isBlank(effect.direction) && !DIRECTIONS.includes(effect.direction)) fail("DIRECTION_INVALID", "direction");
  if (!isBlank(effect.quantity_base) && canonicalQuantity(effect.quantity_base) === null) fail("QUANTITY_INVALID", "quantity_base");
  if (effect.balance_type === "BATCH" && isBlank(effect.batch_id)) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "batch_id");
  if (effect.balance_type === "HU" && isBlank(effect.hu_id)) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "hu_id");
  return errors;
}
function validateRequest(request) {
  const errors = [];
  if (!request || typeof request !== "object") return [{ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: null }];
  for (const f of CONTRACT.request.fields) {
    if (f.name === "effects" || f.name === "source_job_id") continue;
    const v = request[f.name];
    if (f.required && isBlank(v)) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: f.name });
    else if (!isBlank(v) && f.max_length && String(v).length > f.max_length) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: f.name });
  }
  if (!isBlank(request.operation_id) && !/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,64}$/.test(String(request.operation_id))) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "operation_id" });
  if (!isBlank(request.request_hash) && !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(String(request.request_hash))) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_HASH_INVALID", field: "request_hash" });
  if (request.source_job_id === undefined || request.source_job_id === null) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "source_job_id" });
  // Extension field (Task 5): a correction names the operation it corrects and is never that operation itself.
  if (!isBlank(request.original_operation_id)) {
    const orig = String(request.original_operation_id);
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,64}$/.test(orig) || orig === String(request.operation_id)) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "original_operation_id" });
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(request.effects) || request.effects.length === 0) {
    errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "effects" });
    return errors;
  }
  // One operation is one bounded mutation group (request.max_effects, the largest array size proven on the engine).
  // PROVISIONAL engine bound. One operation carries one whole business intent; it is never divided.
  if (request.effects.length > CONTRACT.request.max_effects) {
    return [{ code: "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE", field: "effects", effects: request.effects.length, max_effects: CONTRACT.request.max_effects }];
  }
  const seen = new Set();
  request.effects.forEach((e, i) => {
    errors.push(...validateEffect(e, i));
    if (e && !isBlank(e.effect_key)) {
      if (seen.has(e.effect_key)) errors.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_EFFECT_KEY", field: "effect_key", index: i });
      seen.add(e.effect_key);
    }
  });
  return errors;
}
function canonicalEffect(e) {
  const out = {};
  for (const f of CONTRACT.request.effect_fields) {
    const v = e[f.name];
    if (isBlank(v)) continue;
    out[f.name] = f.name === "quantity_base" ? canonicalQuantity(v) : v;
  }
  return out;
}
function computeRequestHash(request) {
  const body = {};
  for (const k of CONTRACT.request.hash.hashed_fields) {
    if (k === "effects") {
      body.effects = request.effects.map(canonicalEffect).sort((a, b) => cmp(a.effect_key, b.effect_key));
    } else {
      body[k] = request[k] === undefined || request[k] === null ? "" : String(request[k]);
    }
  }
  // Extension fields enter the hash only when present, so every hash computed before they existed stays valid.
  for (const k of CONTRACT.request.hash.hashed_when_present) if (!isBlank(request[k])) body[k] = String(request[k]);
  return sha256Hex(canonicalJson(body));
}
function cmp(a, b) {
  const x = a === undefined || a === null ? "" : String(a);
  const y = b === undefined || b === null ? "" : String(b);
  return x < y ? -1 : x > y ? 1 : 0;
}
function normalizeEffects(effects) {
  if (!Array.isArray(effects) || effects.length === 0) return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "effects" }] };
  const errors = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  effects.forEach((e, i) => {
    errors.push(...validateEffect(e, i));
    if (e && !isBlank(e.effect_key)) {
      if (seen.has(e.effect_key)) errors.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_EFFECT_KEY", field: "effect_key", index: i });
      seen.add(e.effect_key);
    }
  });
  if (errors.length) return { ok: false, errors };

  // The lock row's unique key is case-insensitive (utf8mb4_general_ci): two keys
  // that differ only by case would be one lock row claimed twice by one operation.
  const byUpper = new Map();
  for (const e of effects) {
    const u = String(e.balance_key).toUpperCase();
    if (byUpper.has(u) && byUpper.get(u) !== e.balance_key) {
      return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: "NORMALIZATION_CONFLICT", field: "balance_key", balance_key: e.balance_key }] };
    }
    byUpper.set(u, e.balance_key);
  }

  const uomByKey = new Map();
  for (const e of effects) {
    const prev = uomByKey.get(e.balance_key);
    if (prev !== undefined && prev !== e.uom_base) {
      return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: "NORMALIZATION_CONFLICT", field: "uom_base", balance_key: e.balance_key }] };
    }
    uomByKey.set(e.balance_key, e.uom_base);
  }

  const groups = new Map();
  for (const e of effects) {
    const c = canonicalEffect(e);
    const key = canonicalJson(CONTRACT.normalization.group_key.map((k) => (c[k] === undefined ? null : c[k])));
    const g = groups.get(key);
    if (!g) groups.set(key, { base: c, units: quantityUnits(c.quantity_base), keys: [c.effect_key] });
    else {
      g.units += quantityUnits(c.quantity_base);
      g.keys.push(c.effect_key);
    }
  }

  const out = [...groups.values()].map((g) => {
    const keys = [...g.keys].sort(cmp);
    return { ...g.base, effect_key: keys[0], quantity_base: fromUnits(g.units), merged_effect_keys: keys };
  });
  out.sort((a, b) => cmp(a.balance_key, b.balance_key) || cmp(a.stock_status, b.stock_status) || cmp(a.direction, b.direction) || cmp(a.movement_type, b.movement_type) || cmp(a.effect_key, b.effect_key));
  out.forEach((e, i) => {
    e.effect_sequence = i + 1;
  });
  return { ok: true, effects: out, lockKeys: lockOrder(out) };
}
function lockOrder(effects) {
  return [...new Set(effects.map((e) => e.balance_key))].sort(cmp);
}
function gateTaken(op) {
  return !!op && (op.gate_taken === true || (op.gate_taken !== null && op.gate_taken !== undefined && String(op.gate_taken).trim() === "1"));
}
function gateDecision(op) {
  if (!gateTaken(op)) return "";
  const owner = op.gate_owner === undefined || op.gate_owner === null ? "" : String(op.gate_owner).trim();
  if (owner.indexOf("REJECT|") === 0) return "REJECT";
  if (owner.indexOf("APPLY|") === 0) return "APPLY";
  return "UNKNOWN";
}
function gateRejectCode(op) {
  const parts = String(op && op.gate_owner ? op.gate_owner : "").split("|");
  const rc = RESULT_CODES[parts[1]];
  return rc && rc.response_status === "REJECTED" ? parts[1] : "STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION";
}
function mutationMayHaveStarted(op) {
  return !!op && (MUTATION_STARTED.includes(op.operation_status) || !isBlank(op.mutation_started_at) || (PRE_MUTATION.includes(op.operation_status) && gateTaken(op) && gateDecision(op) !== "REJECT"));
}
function isUncertain(op) {
  return !!op && op.operation_status !== "DONE" && mutationMayHaveStarted(op);
}
const DB_TIME_RE = /^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})(?:\.(\d{1,6}))?$/;
function dbTime(value) {
  const m = typeof value === "string" ? value.match(DB_TIME_RE) : null;
  if (!m) throw new Error(`not a DB column time 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS': ${String(value)}`);
  return `${m[1]}.${(m[2] || "").padEnd(6, "0")}`;
}
function leaseExpired(op, now) {
  if (isBlank(op.lease_expires_at)) return true;
  return dbTime(op.lease_expires_at) < dbTime(now);
}
function buildResponse(op, resultCode) {
  const code = resultCode || op.result_code;
  const rc = RESULT_CODES[code];
  if (!rc) throw new Error(`unknown result_code ${code}`);
  const res = {
    operation_id: op.operation_id,
    operation_status: rc.response_status,
    result_code: code,
    effect_summary: op.effect_summary || { effect_count: 0, lock_count: 0, by_status: {}, effects: [] },
  };
  if (rc.response_status === "REQUIRES_REVIEW") res.review_reference = op.review_reference || op.operation_id;
  return res;
}
function decideOnRepeat(stored, incoming, now) {
  if (!stored) return { decision: DECISIONS.PROCEED };
  if (stored.request_hash !== incoming.request_hash) {
    return { decision: DECISIONS.CONFLICT, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: incoming.operation_id }, "OPERATION_HASH_CONFLICT") };
  }
  // DONE first: a completed operation carries mutation_started_at by design.
  if (stored.operation_status === "DONE") {
    return { decision: DECISIONS.NOOP_RETURN_STORED, response: buildResponse(stored, "OK_REPLAYED") };
  }
  if (isUncertain(stored)) {
    // Never proceed. A live MUTATING/VERIFYING run is only waited for; a stale
    // one, an inconsistent row or REQUIRES_REVIEW answers REQUIRES_REVIEW.
    // A pre-mutation row whose APPLY gate was just taken (no mutation_started_at yet) is
    // as live as MUTATING while its lease holds.
    const gateDecided = PRE_MUTATION.includes(stored.operation_status) && gateTaken(stored) && isBlank(stored.mutation_started_at);
    const running = (["MUTATING", "VERIFYING"].includes(stored.operation_status) || gateDecided) && !leaseExpired(stored, now);
    if (running) return { decision: DECISIONS.IN_PROGRESS, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS") };
    const code = stored.operation_status === "REQUIRES_REVIEW" && stored.result_code ? stored.result_code : ["MUTATING", "VERIFYING"].includes(stored.operation_status) ? "STALE_AFTER_MUTATION_STARTED" : "OPERATION_UNDER_REVIEW";
    return { decision: DECISIONS.NOT_RETRYABLE, response: buildResponse(stored, code) };
  }
  const rejectGate = gateDecision(stored) === "REJECT";
  const live = !leaseExpired(stored, now);
  if (stored.operation_status === "REJECTED" && (!rejectGate || live)) {
    return { decision: DECISIONS.NOOP_RETURN_STORED, response: buildResponse(stored) };
  }
  if (rejectGate) {
    if (live) return { decision: DECISIONS.IN_PROGRESS, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS") };
    const code = stored.operation_status === "REJECTED" && stored.result_code ? stored.result_code : gateRejectCode(stored);
    return { decision: DECISIONS.RECOVER, finish: true, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id, effect_summary: stored.effect_summary }, code) };
  }
  if (PRE_MUTATION.includes(stored.operation_status)) {
    if (live) return { decision: DECISIONS.IN_PROGRESS, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS") };
    const code = stored.operation_status === "LOCKING" ? "LOCK_CONFLICT" : "STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION";
    return { decision: DECISIONS.RECOVER, finish: false, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, code) };
  }
  throw new Error(`unknown operation_status ${stored.operation_status}`);
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"res_hidden":"Processing","max_effects":20000,"movement_type":"GDL","header_fields":["plant_id","customer_name","currency_code","so_no","pp_no","so_id","gd_billing_address","gd_shipping_address","delivery_no","gd_contact_name","contact_number","email_address","gd_delivery_method","delivery_date","document_description","assigned_to","organization_id","gd_created_by","acc_integration_type","reference_type","gd_ref_doc","last_sync_date","customer_credit_limit","overdue_limit","outstanding_balance","overdue_inv_total_amount","is_accurate","driver_name","ic_no","driver_contact_no","vehicle_no","pickup_date","validity_of_collection","courier_company","shipping_date","freight_charges","tracking_number","est_arrival_date","est_delivery_date","delivery_cost","shipping_company","shipping_method","tpt_vehicle_number","tpt_transport_name","tpt_ic_no","tpt_driver_contact_no","select_vehicle_id","gd_vehicle_type","gd_vehicle_capacity","gd_vehicle_cap_uom","select_driver_id","gd_driver_contact","gd_driver_ic","gd_total","order_tnc","order_payment_details","order_delivery_term","order_remark","order_remark2","order_remark3","order_remark4","order_remark5","picking_status","billing_address_name","billing_address_phone","billing_address_line_1","billing_address_line_2","billing_address_line_3","billing_address_line_4","billing_address_city","billing_postal_code","billing_address_state","billing_address_country","billing_attention","billing_address_fax","billing_address_code","shipping_address_code","shipping_address_fax","shipping_address_name","shipping_address_phone","shipping_address_line_1","shipping_address_line_2","shipping_address_line_3","shipping_address_line_4","shipping_address_city","shipping_postal_code","shipping_address_state","shipping_address_country","shipping_attention","delivery_no_type","to_no","is_select_picking","pp_id","sp_vehicle_no","gd_area_id","tpt_driver_name","di_shipping_method","di_driver_name","di_ic_no","di_driver_contact_no","di_shipping_company","di_transport_name","di_vehicle_number","di_est_delivery_date","di_est_arrival_date","di_pickup_date","di_validity_of_collection","di_tracking_number","di_freight_charges","project_id","sales_person"]};
const dec8 = function dec8() {
  const S = 100000000n;
  const parse = (v) => {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) return null;
    const m = String(v).trim().match(/^(-)?([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]+))?$/);
    if (!m) return null;
    const frac = m[3] || "";
    if (frac.length > 8 && /[1-9]/.test(frac.slice(8))) return null;
    const u = BigInt(m[2]) * S + BigInt((frac.slice(0, 8) + "00000000").slice(0, 8));
    return m[1] ? -u : u;
  };
  const fmt = (u) => {
    const neg = u < 0n;
    const a = neg ? -u : u;
    const f = (a % S).toString().padStart(8, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
    return (neg ? "-" : "") + (a / S).toString() + (f ? "." + f : "");
  };
  const mul = (a, b) => {
    const p = a * b;
    const neg = p < 0n;
    const q = ((neg ? -p : p) + S / 2n) / S;
    return neg ? -q : q;
  };
  const same = (a, b) => {
    const x = parse(a);
    const y = parse(b);
    return x !== null && y !== null && x === y;
  };
  return { S: S, parse: parse, fmt: fmt, mul: mul, same: same };
};
const withAutoAllocation = function withAutoAllocation(parse, alloc) {
  const a = alloc || {};
  const by = {};
  for (const r of Array.isArray(a.autoRows) ? a.autoRows : []) by[r.i] = r;
  const lines = (Array.isArray(parse.lines) ? parse.lines : []).map((l, i) => (by[i] ? Object.assign({}, l, { allocations: by[i].allocations, raw: Object.assign({}, l.raw || {}, by[i].patch), auto_allocated: 1 }) : l));
  return Object.assign({}, parse, { lines: lines, autoErrors: Array.isArray(a.autoErrors) ? a.autoErrors : [], locationIdsSql: a.locationIdsSql || parse.locationIdsSql, tuplesSql: a.tuplesSql || parse.tuplesSql, pickingRequired: String(a.pickingRequired) === "1" ? 1 : 0 });
};
const prepareValidate = function prepareValidate(guard, parse, reads) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const arr = (x) => (Array.isArray(x) ? x : x ? [x] : []).filter((r) => r && !(r.id === null && r.kind === undefined && r.material_id === undefined));
  const D = dec8();
  const R = reads || {};
  const jobId = parse.jobId;
  const org = parse.organizationId;
  const plant = parse.plantId;
  const header = parse.header || {};
  const deliveryNo = s(header.delivery_no);
  const errors = [];
  const err = (line, field, code, message, seq) => errors.push({ line_no: line ? line.line_no : null, stable_line_key: line ? line.stable_line_key : "", allocation_sequence: seq === undefined ? null : seq, field: field, code: code, message: message });
  // the auto allocation's refusals (prepareAutoAllocate: the old save stops the whole save on the first)
  for (const e of Array.isArray(parse.autoErrors) ? parse.autoErrors : []) errors.push(e);
  // ---- master maps
  const items = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.items)) if (s(r.id)) items[s(r.id)] = r;
  const conv = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.uoms)) {
    if (String(r.is_deleted) !== "0") continue;
    const k = s(r.item_id) + "|" + s(r.alt_uom_id);
    if (!conv[k]) conv[k] = [];
    conv[k].push(r);
  }
  const bins = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.bins)) if (s(r.id)) bins[s(r.id)] = r;
  const bal = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.balances)) {
    if (!s(r.id)) continue;
    const k = s(r.material_id) + "," + s(r.location_id);
    if (!bal[k]) bal[k] = [];
    bal[k].push(r);
  }
  // blockers: SERIAL_ROWS per (material, bin); BATCH_ROWS per (material, bin, batch) with the batch row's Unrestricted
  // (a non-batch material with batch rows at the bin is refused; a batch material is checked on its batch row - D-1)
  const blockers = {};
  const batchRows = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.blockers)) {
    if (!s(r.kind)) continue;
    const k = s(r.kind) + "|" + s(r.material_id) + "|" + s(r.location_id);
    blockers[k] = (blockers[k] || 0) + (Number(r.n) || 0);
    if (s(r.kind) === "BATCH_ROWS") batchRows[s(r.material_id) + "," + s(r.location_id) + "," + s(r.batch_id)] = { n: Number(r.n) || 0, qty: s(r.qty) };
  }
  // the costing method -> costing_context.method; FIFO and Weighted Average are priced by the inventory operation under
  // its lock (D-5: the price the frozen SUBTRACT stamps on a reservation; no costing row is written)
  const METHOD = { "Fixed Cost": "FIXED_COST", "First In First Out": "FIFO", "Weighted Average": "WEIGHTED_AVERAGE" };
  const sos = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.sos)) if (s(r.id)) sos[s(r.id)] = r;
  const soLines = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.soLines)) if (s(r.id)) soLines[s(r.id)] = r;
  const pending = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.pending)) if (s(r.parent_line_id)) pending[s(r.parent_line_id)] = (pending[s(r.parent_line_id)] || 0) + 1;
  // quantity already committed by OTHER hidden (Processing) deliveries, per sales order line (fail-closed: counted as delivered)
  const hidden = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.hidden)) if (s(r.so_line_id)) hidden[s(r.so_line_id)] = D.parse(r.qty) || 0n;
  const soProjection = [];
  // packing: the organization's packing setup (plant row first, else the organization row) and its Packing serial rule
  const setups = arr(R.packing).filter((r) => s(r.id) && String(r.is_deleted) === "0");
  const setup = setups.filter((r) => s(r.plant_id) === plant)[0] || setups.filter((r) => !s(r.plant_id) || s(r.plant_id) === "0" || s(r.plant_id) === "null")[0] || setups[0] || null;
  const rules = arr(R.rules).filter((r) => s(r.id) && String(r.is_deleted) === "0").sort((a, b) => (Number(b.is_default) || 0) - (Number(a.is_default) || 0) || (Number(a.is_draft) || 0) - (Number(b.is_draft) || 0) || (s(a.id) < s(b.id) ? -1 : 1));
  const packingRequired = setup && String(setup.packing_required) === "1" ? 1 : 0;
  const mode = s(header.allocation_mode) || "RESERVE";
  if (["RESERVE", "ITEM_ONLY"].indexOf(mode) < 0) errors.push({ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", allocation_sequence: null, field: "allocation_mode", code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", message: "allocation_mode: RESERVE or ITEM_ONLY" });
  else if (mode === "ITEM_ONLY" && org !== "0") errors.push({ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", allocation_sequence: null, field: "allocation_mode", code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", message: "allocation_mode ITEM_ONLY is the organization-0 test shape only" });
  if (packingRequired && !rules.length) errors.push({ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", allocation_sequence: null, field: "packing", code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", message: "packing is required by the packing setup but the organization has no Packing serial-number rule" });
  // the document number: any goods_delivery row (live or soft-deleted: the unique index keeps a deleted row's key) with
  // this organization's delivery_no makes the delivery unpublishable (fix round 1, I1)
  // (OI4: a delivery numbered on insert - "issued" - has no number to check yet; the rule issues a fresh one)
  const docRows = deliveryNo === "issued" ? [] : arr(R.docno).filter((r) => s(r.id));
  if (docRows.length) errors.push({ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", allocation_sequence: null, field: "delivery_no", code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", message: "document number " + deliveryNo + " already used by goods delivery " + s(docRows[0].id) + (String(docRows[0].is_deleted) === "0" ? "" : " (deleted; the number stays occupied)") });
  const stageById = {};
  const stageByKey = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.stage)) {
    if (!s(r.id)) continue;
    stageById[s(r.id)] = r;
    stageByKey[s(r.stable_line_key) + "|" + s(r.allocation_sequence)] = r;
  }
  // ---- per line
  const outSum = {};
  const effects = [];
  const stageRows = [];
  const reservations = [];
  const lines = [];
  const confirmations = {};
  const docDate = s(header.delivery_date);
  const headerSoNo = s(header.so_no);
  // item bundles (decided 2026-10-03, B-2 / B-3): the bundle row of each item, by the item's parent_key
  const lineByKey = {};
  for (const l0 of parse.lines) lineByKey[l0.stable_line_key] = l0;
  for (const line of parse.lines) {
    // The item bundle row (kind BUNDLE): no material, nothing delivered against it - no item / unit / stock check, no
    // effect, no reservation, no sales order projection (the old save leaves the bundle's sales order line untouched on
    // Created: code_node_QtyCheckBatch updates it only when saveAs === "Completed"). What the old save does check on it
    // (code_node_IyJHrBst, the descriptive-line branch): a description. V2's own structural checks: its sales order
    // line is a bundle line of the same order (and its items' lines hang under it, below).
    if (line.kind === "BUNDLE") {
      const braw = line.raw || {};
      let bOk = true;
      if (!s(braw.material_name) && !s(braw.gd_material_desc)) {
        err(line, "material_name", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "row has no material_id and no description");
        bOk = false;
      }
      if (line.so_line_id) {
        const bsl = soLines[line.so_line_id];
        if (!bsl || String(bsl.is_deleted) !== "0" || s(bsl.sales_order_id) !== line.so_id) {
          err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line " + line.so_line_id + " not found on sales order " + line.so_id);
          bOk = false;
        } else if (!s(bsl.item_bundle_id) || s(bsl.material_id)) {
          err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line " + line.so_line_id + " is not an item bundle line");
          bOk = false;
        } else if (s(bsl.item_bundle_id) !== s(line.item_bundle_id)) {
          err(line, "item_bundle_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "item bundle " + s(line.item_bundle_id) + " differs from the sales order line's bundle " + s(bsl.item_bundle_id));
          bOk = false;
        }
      }
      lines.push({ line: line, it: null, ok: bOk, baseUom: "", baseQty: line.quantity, allocs: [], bundle: true });
      continue;
    }
    const bundleRow = line.parent_key ? lineByKey[line.parent_key] : null;
    // a bundle is delivered as a whole (code_node_IyJHrBst bundleRatioProblem): an item's quantity is its ordered
    // quantity per bundle times the number of bundles delivered - expected = item.gd_order_quantity /
    // bundle.gd_order_quantity x bundle.gd_qty, refused when |gd_qty - expected| > 0.001; no check when the bundle's
    // ordered quantity is not > 0. Compared exactly: |q x O - o x Q| > 0.001 x O (q / o the item's delivered /
    // ordered, Q / O the bundle's).
    if (bundleRow && bundleRow.kind === "BUNDLE") {
      const O = D.parse(s((bundleRow.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) || 0n;
      if (O > 0n) {
        const Q = D.parse(bundleRow.quantity) || 0n;
        const o = D.parse(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) || 0n;
        const q = D.parse(line.quantity) || 0n;
        const gap = q * O - o * Q;
        if ((gap < 0n ? -gap : gap) > 100000n * O) {
          const expected = ((parseFloat(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) || 0) / (parseFloat(s((bundleRow.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) || 0)) * (parseFloat(bundleRow.quantity) || 0);
          err(line, "gd_qty", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "item bundle quantities must stay in proportion - expected " + expected.toFixed(3) + ", got " + (parseFloat(line.quantity) || 0).toFixed(3) + ". Deliver an item bundle by its bundle line - its items follow from it and cannot be delivered on their own.");
        }
      }
    }
    const it = items[line.material_id];
    const lineIdx = line.line_no;
    let lineOk = true;
    if (!it || String(it.is_deleted) !== "0") {
      err(line, "material_id", "GD_INVALID_ITEM", "material " + line.material_id + " not found in organization " + org + " or deleted");
      lineOk = false;
    } else {
      if (String(it.stock_control) !== "1") {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "material is not stock-controlled");
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (!METHOD[s(it.material_costing_method)]) {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "costing method '" + s(it.material_costing_method) + "' is not supported by the V2 inventory path (Fixed Cost, First In First Out or Weighted Average; inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)");
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (["0", "1"].indexOf(String(it.item_batch_management)) < 0) {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "item_batch_management is " + String(it.item_batch_management) + " (0 or 1 expected)");
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (String(it.serial_number_management) !== "0") {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "serial-managed material is not supported by the V2 inventory path yet (inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)");
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (s(it.material_costing_method) === "Fixed Cost" && (D.parse(it.purchase_unit_price) === null || D.parse(it.purchase_unit_price) < 0n)) {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "purchase_unit_price is empty or unreadable (Fixed Cost price)");
        lineOk = false;
      }
    }
    // unit of measure -> base
    let factorNum = 1n;
    let factorDen = 1n;
    const baseUom = it ? s(it.based_uom) : "";
    if (it && lineOk) {
      if (line.uom_id !== baseUom) {
        const rows = conv[line.material_id + "|" + line.uom_id] || [];
        if (rows.length !== 1) {
          err(line, "gd_order_uom_id", "GD_INVALID_UOM", rows.length ? "several conversions for this unit" : "unit " + line.uom_id + " has no conversion to the base unit of the material");
          lineOk = false;
        } else {
          const bq = D.parse(rows[0].base_qty);
          const aq = D.parse(rows[0].alt_qty);
          if (bq === null || aq === null || bq <= 0n || aq <= 0n || s(rows[0].base_uom_id) !== baseUom) {
            err(line, "gd_order_uom_id", "GD_INVALID_UOM", "conversion row is unusable (base_qty / alt_qty / base_uom_id)");
            lineOk = false;
          } else {
            factorNum = bq;
            factorDen = aq;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const qtyUnits = D.parse(line.quantity);
    if (qtyUnits === null || qtyUnits < 0n) {
      err(line, "gd_qty", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "gd_qty unreadable");
      lineOk = false;
    }
    if (qtyUnits === 0n || !line.allocations.length) confirmations.ZERO_QUANTITY = true;
    if (s((line.raw || {}).line_pp_id) || s((line.raw || {}).pp_line_item_id)) {
      err(line, "line_pp_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "picking-plan-linked lines are not supported by the V2 path yet");
      lineOk = false;
    }
    // sales order state (only when the line names one)
    if (line.so_id) {
      const so = sos[line.so_id];
      if (!so || String(so.is_deleted) !== "0") {
        err(line, "line_so_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order " + line.so_id + " not found");
        lineOk = false;
      } else if (["Cancelled", "Completed", "Closed"].indexOf(s(so.so_status)) >= 0) {
        err(line, "line_so_id", "GD_SO_CLOSED", "sales order is " + s(so.so_status));
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (line.so_line_id) {
        const sl = soLines[line.so_line_id];
        if (!sl || String(sl.is_deleted) !== "0" || s(sl.sales_order_id) !== line.so_id) {
          err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line " + line.so_line_id + " not found on sales order " + line.so_id);
          lineOk = false;
        } else {
          if (s(sl.material_id) && s(sl.material_id) !== line.material_id) {
            err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line is for another material");
            lineOk = false;
          }
          // an item of a bundle delivers an item line of the bundle's own sales order line (sales_order_axszx8cj_sub:
          // an item line's parent_id is its bundle line)
          if (bundleRow && bundleRow.kind === "BUNDLE" && bundleRow.so_line_id && s(sl.parent_id) !== bundleRow.so_line_id) {
            err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line " + line.so_line_id + " is not an item of the bundle's sales order line " + bundleRow.so_line_id);
            lineOk = false;
          }
          if (["Cancelled", "Completed"].indexOf(s(sl.line_status)) >= 0) {
            err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_SO_CLOSED", "sales order line is " + s(sl.line_status));
            lineOk = false;
          }
          if (pending[line.so_line_id]) {
            err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED", "the sales order line carries a pending reservation (on_reserved_gd Pending): the old save allocates from it first; consuming a pending reservation is not implemented by the V2 path");
            lineOk = false;
          }
          // over-delivery (gd_workflow.json code_node_QtyCheckBatch, a new delivery saved as Created): delivered + planned
          // + this delivery must not exceed the ordered quantity plus the unit's over-delivery tolerance; hidden
          // deliveries of other jobs count as committed (ruling D-R6)
          const ordered = D.parse(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) !== null && D.parse(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) > 0n ? D.parse(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) : D.parse(sl.so_quantity) || 0n;
          const tolRows = conv[line.material_id + "|" + line.uom_id] || [];
          const tolUnits = tolRows.length === 1 ? D.parse(tolRows[0].over_delivery_tolerance) || 0n : D.parse((it || {}).over_delivery_tolerance) || 0n;
          const limit = (ordered * (100n * D.S + tolUnits)) / (100n * D.S);
          const committed = (D.parse(sl.delivered_qty) || 0n) + (D.parse(sl.planned_qty) || 0n) + (hidden[line.so_line_id] || 0n) + (qtyUnits || 0n);
          if (committed > limit) {
            err(line, "gd_qty", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "quantity is exceeding the maximum deliverable quantity (delivered " + D.fmt(D.parse(sl.delivered_qty) || 0n) + " + planned " + D.fmt(D.parse(sl.planned_qty) || 0n) + " + processing " + D.fmt(hidden[line.so_line_id] || 0n) + " + this " + D.fmt(qtyUnits || 0n) + " > " + D.fmt(limit) + ")");
            lineOk = false;
          } else if (qtyUnits !== null && qtyUnits > 0n) soProjection.push({ so_line_id: line.so_line_id, so_id: line.so_id, delta: D.fmt(qtyUnits), limit: D.fmt(limit) });
        }
      }
    }
    // allocations -> effects
    const base8 = (u) => D.fmt((u * factorNum + factorDen / 2n) / factorDen);
    const lineBaseUnits = qtyUnits === null ? 0n : (qtyUnits * factorNum + factorDen / 2n) / factorDen;
    const allocOut = [];
    const isBatch = !!it && String(it.item_batch_management) === "1";
    for (const a of line.allocations) {
      const seq = a.allocation_sequence;
      let aOk = lineOk;
      if (a.hu_id) {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "allocation " + seq + ": handling-unit stock is not supported by the V2 inventory path yet (inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)", seq);
        aOk = false;
      }
      if (it && lineOk && isBatch && !/^[0-9]{1,19}$/.test(s(a.batch_id))) {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": the material is batch-managed: the allocation needs its batch (select the batch in Select Stock)", seq);
        aOk = false;
      }
      if (it && lineOk && !isBatch && s(a.batch_id)) {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": the material is not batch-managed, the allocation names batch " + s(a.batch_id), seq);
        aOk = false;
      }
      const bin = bins[a.location_id];
      if (!bin || String(bin.is_deleted) !== "0") {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": bin " + a.location_id + " not found", seq);
        aOk = false;
      } else if (s(bin.plant_id) !== plant || s(bin.organization_id) !== org) {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": bin " + a.location_id + " belongs to another plant or organization", seq);
        aOk = false;
      } else if (String(bin.bin_status) !== "1") {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": bin " + a.location_id + " is inactive", seq);
        aOk = false;
      }
      const au = D.parse(a.quantity);
      const baseQty = au === null ? "0" : base8(au);
      const tupleKey = line.material_id + "," + a.location_id;
      // the bucket the sufficiency check sums: the item row, or for a batch material its batch row (the frozen SUBTRACT
      // checks the batch row only, legacy-costing-batch-spec.md 7.1)
      const stockKey = isBatch ? tupleKey + "," + s(a.batch_id) : tupleKey;
      if (aOk && it) {
        const rows = bal[tupleKey] || [];
        if (rows.length !== 1) {
          err(line, "temp_qty_data", rows.length ? "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED" : "GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "allocation " + seq + ": " + (rows.length ? rows.length + " item_balance rows for the material at this bin (inventory BALANCE_STATE_INVALID)" : "no stock balance for the material at bin " + a.location_id), seq);
          aOk = false;
        } else if (s(rows[0].material_uom) && s(rows[0].material_uom) !== baseUom) {
          err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "allocation " + seq + ": the balance row's unit differs from the material's base unit", seq);
          aOk = false;
        }
        if (isBatch) {
          const br = batchRows[stockKey];
          if (!br || br.n !== 1) {
            err(line, "temp_qty_data", br ? "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED" : "GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "allocation " + seq + ": " + (br ? br.n + " item_batch_balance rows for batch " + s(a.batch_id) + " at this bin (inventory BALANCE_STATE_INVALID)" : "no stock of batch " + s(a.batch_id) + " at bin " + a.location_id), seq);
            aOk = false;
          }
        } else if (blockers["BATCH_ROWS|" + line.material_id + "|" + a.location_id]) {
          err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "allocation " + seq + ": batch balance rows exist at this bin for a material that is not batch-managed (inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)", seq);
          aOk = false;
        }
        if (blockers["SERIAL_ROWS|" + line.material_id + "|" + a.location_id]) {
          err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "allocation " + seq + ": serial balance rows exist at this bin (inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)", seq);
          aOk = false;
        }
      }
      if (aOk) {
        if (!outSum[stockKey]) outSum[stockKey] = 0n;
        outSum[stockKey] += D.parse(baseQty);
      }
      allocOut.push({ seq: seq, a: a, ok: aOk, baseQty: baseQty, tupleKey: stockKey, isBatch: isBatch });
    }
    lines.push({ line: line, it: it, ok: lineOk, baseUom: baseUom, baseQty: D.fmt(lineBaseUnits), allocs: allocOut });
  }
  // aggregate sufficiency, read-only (the inventory operation re-checks under its locks)
  for (const k of Object.keys(outSum)) {
    const parts = k.split(",");
    const row = parts.length === 3 ? (batchRows[k] ? { unrestricted_qty: batchRows[k].qty } : null) : (bal[k] || [])[0];
    const have = row ? (s(row.unrestricted_qty) === "" ? 0n : D.parse(row.unrestricted_qty)) : null;
    if (have === null || have < outSum[k]) {
      for (const L of lines) for (const A of L.allocs) if (A.ok && A.tupleKey === k) {
        A.ok = false;
        err(L.line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "allocation " + A.seq + ": unrestricted stock " + (have === null ? "0" : D.fmt(have)) + " at bin " + A.a.location_id + (parts.length === 3 ? " (batch " + parts[2] + ")" : "") + " is less than the " + D.fmt(outSum[k]) + " requested by this delivery", A.seq);
      }

    // in its items' keys L<i>.<j>), so P2's gd_line_id stamping stays uniform
    if (L.bundle) {
      const eb = errors.filter((e) => e.stable_line_key === line.stable_line_key)[0];
      stageRows.push({ job_id: jobId, organization_id: org, stable_line_key: line.stable_line_key, allocation_sequence: 0, payload_hash: parse.payloadHash, gd_line_index: line.line_no, so_id: line.so_id || "", so_line_id: line.so_line_id || "", material_id: "", material_code: "", uom_id: line.uom_id, base_uom_id: "", requested_qty: line.quantity, base_qty: line.quantity, plant_id: plant, location_id: "", batch_id: "", hu_id: "", allocation_strategy: "BUNDLE", effect_key_out: "", effect_key_in: "", picking_projection: "", costing_input: "", line_status: eb ? "INVALID" : "VALID", error_code: eb ? eb.code : "", error_message: eb ? eb.message : "" });
      continue;
    }
    const it = L.it || {};
    const method = L.it ? METHOD[s(it.material_costing_method)] || "FIXED_COST" : "FIXED_COST";
    const cc = { method: method, trx_no: deliveryNo, doc_date: docDate };
    // a Fixed Cost price is the master's; FIFO / Weighted Average are priced by the inventory operation under its lock
    if (method === "FIXED_COST") cc.unit_price = L.it && D.parse(it.purchase_unit_price) !== null ? D.fmt(D.parse(it.purchase_unit_price)) : "0";
    const parentNo = line.so_no || headerSoNo;
    if (parentNo) cc.parent_trx_no = parentNo;
    const lineErrors = errors.filter((e) => e.stable_line_key === line.stable_line_key);
    if (!L.allocs.length) {
      const e0 = lineErrors.filter((e) => e.allocation_sequence === null)[0];
      stageRows.push({ job_id: jobId, organization_id: org, stable_line_key: line.stable_line_key, allocation_sequence: 0, payload_hash: parse.payloadHash, gd_line_index: line.line_no, so_id: line.so_id || "", so_line_id: line.so_line_id || "", material_id: line.material_id, material_code: s(it.material_code), uom_id: line.uom_id, base_uom_id: L.baseUom, requested_qty: line.quantity, base_qty: L.baseQty, plant_id: plant, location_id: "", batch_id: "", hu_id: "", allocation_strategy: "NONE", effect_key_out: "", effect_key_in: "", picking_projection: "", costing_input: "", line_status: e0 ? "INVALID" : "VALID", error_code: e0 ? e0.code : "", error_message: e0 ? e0.message : "" });
    }
    for (const A of L.allocs) {
      const a = A.a;
      const seq = A.seq;
      // a batch material moves its batch row (and, inside the inventory operation, the item aggregate row): BATCH effects
      const type = A.isBatch ? "BATCH" : "ITEM";
      const keyOut = line.line_no + "." + seq + "." + type + ".OUT";
      const keyIn = line.line_no + "." + seq + "." + type + ".IN";
      const bk = A.isBatch ? "BATCH|" + line.material_id + "|" + a.location_id + "|" + s(a.batch_id) : "ITEM|" + line.material_id + "|" + a.location_id;
      const bx = A.isBatch ? { batch_id: s(a.batch_id) } : {};
      const aErr = lineErrors.filter((e) => e.allocation_sequence === null || e.allocation_sequence === seq)[0];
      const ok = A.ok && !aErr;
      if (ok) {
        effects.push(Object.assign({ effect_key: keyOut, balance_type: type, balance_key: bk, direction: "OUT", quantity_base: A.baseQty, uom_base: L.baseUom, stock_status: "Unrestricted", movement_type: GDC.movement_type, costing_context: cc }, bx));
        effects.push(Object.assign({ effect_key: keyIn, balance_type: type, balance_key: bk, direction: "IN", quantity_base: A.baseQty, uom_base: L.baseUom, stock_status: "Reserved", movement_type: GDC.movement_type, costing_context: cc }, bx));
        effectCount += mode === "RESERVE" ? 3 : 2; // + the RESERVATION IN of the hidden reservation row (D-4)
        if (mode === "RESERVE") reservations.push({ doc_type: "Good Delivery", status: GDC.res_hidden, parent_id: line.so_id || null, parent_line_id: line.so_line_id || null, parent_no: parentNo || null, doc_no: deliveryNo, doc_id: "", doc_line_id: "", material_id: line.material_id, item_code: s(it.material_code), item_name: s(it.material_name), item_desc: s(it.material_desc), batch_id: A.isBatch ? s(a.batch_id) : null, bin_location: a.location_id, item_uom: line.uom_id, reserved_qty: a.quantity, delivered_qty: "0", open_qty: a.quantity, reserved_date: docDate, line_no: line.line_no, plant_id: plant, organization_id: org, remark: null, target_gd_id: "", source_reserved_id: null, handling_unit_id: null, job_line_key: jobId + "|" + line.stable_line_key + "|" + seq, stable_line_key: line.stable_line_key, allocation_sequence: seq });
      }
      stageRows.push({ job_id: jobId, organization_id: org, stable_line_key: line.stable_line_key, allocation_sequence: seq, payload_hash: parse.payloadHash, gd_line_index: line.line_no, so_id: line.so_id || "", so_line_id: line.so_line_id || "", material_id: line.material_id, material_code: s(it.material_code), uom_id: line.uom_id, base_uom_id: L.baseUom, requested_qty: a.quantity, base_qty: A.baseQty, plant_id: plant, location_id: a.location_id, batch_id: a.batch_id || "", hu_id: a.hu_id || "", allocation_strategy: "UNRESTRICTED_TO_RESERVED", effect_key_out: ok ? keyOut : "", effect_key_in: ok ? keyIn : "", picking_projection: "", costing_input: ok ? canonicalJson(Object.assign({ balance_type: type, balance_key: bk, uom_base: L.baseUom, stock_out: "Unrestricted", stock_in: "Reserved", movement_type: GDC.movement_type, costing_context: cc }, bx)) : "", line_status: ok ? "VALID" : "INVALID", error_code: aErr ? aErr.code : "", error_message: aErr ? aErr.message : "" });
    }
  }
  const thousands = (x) => String(x).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
  if (effectCount > GDC.max_effects) err(null, "lines", "GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS", "This delivery is too large for one save: after stock allocation it needs " + thousands(effectCount) + " inventory effects and one save can carry at most " + thousands(Math.floor(GDC.max_effects / 3)) + " stock allocations (" + thousands(GDC.max_effects) + " inventory effects).   // confirmations
  const needed = Object.keys(confirmations).sort();
  const confirmationHash = needed.length ? sha256Hex(canonicalJson(needed)) : "";
  const confirmed = !needed.length || confirmationHash === parse.confirmationHash;
  // stage rows: insert the ones that do not exist yet, update the ones that do (unique STAGE_LINE, F15 / F24)
  const stageAddRows = [];
  const stageUpdRows = [];
  for (const r of stageRows) {
    const ex = stageByKey[r.stable_line_key + "|" + r.allocation_sequence];
    if (ex) stageUpdRows.push(Object.assign({ id: String(ex.id) }, r));
    else stageAddRows.push(r);
  }
  // the GD lines the hidden header will carry: the payload line as submitted + the keys this path sets. Every line -
  // an item bundle row and its items included - carries the header values the old save copies onto each surviving row
  // (code_node_IyJHrBst, both branches: customer_id, organization_id, plant_id, billing / shipping state and country,
  // assigned_to, area_id, line_index; parity fix 2026-10-03: V2 lines had none of them).
  const stampHeader = (out) => {
    out.customer_id = header.customer_name || null;
    out.organization_id = org;
    out.plant_id = plant || null;
    out.billing_state_id = header.billing_address_state || null;
    out.billing_country_id = header.billing_address_country || null;
    out.shipping_state_id = header.shipping_address_state || null;
    out.shipping_country_id = header.shipping_address_country || null;
    out.assigned_to = header.assigned_to || null;
    out.area_id = header.gd_area_id || null;
    return out;
  };
  // the old save's Created stamps of the bundle row (code_node_IyJHrBst descriptive-line branch, saveAs Created, not
  // from a Picking): picking_status "Completed" when the organization's setup requires picking (gdSetup

      out.material_id = "";

  });

  // (the engine stores the bundle row, then each item with parent_id = the bundle row's id: survey section 3)
  const gdLines = [];

  for (const g of gdFlat) {
    const top = g.parent ? topByKey[g.parent] : null;
    if (top) {

    } else {

    }

  hdr.plant_id = plant;

  // characters (inventory request.fields max_length 64); a form key of a real organization is longer
  // (GDF:<19-digit org>:<number>:<16 hex>:<16 hex>:<gen>, 71+ characters; pass 10101 job 2105847292639522817 was

  if (errors.length) route = "FAIL";
  else if (!confirmed) route = "CONFIRM";
  return {
    route: route,
    errors: errors,
    effects: effects,
    effectCount: effects.length,
    stageRows: stageRows,
    stageAddRows: stageAddRows,
    stageUpdRows: stageUpdRows,

    result_message: first ? first.message : route === "CONFIRM" ? "confirmation needed: " + needed.join(", ") : "",
  };

// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,

const writeBatches = function writeBatches(rows, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const batches = [];
  for (let i = 0; i * n < list.length; i++) batches.push({ i: i, from: i * n, to: Math.min(list.length, (i + 1) * n) });
  return { batches: batches, count: batches.length, total: list.length };
};

const writeBatches = function writeBatches(rows, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const batches = [];
  for (let i = 0; i * n < list.length; i++) batches.push({ i: i, from: i * n, to: Math.min(list.length, (i + 1) * n) });
  return { batches: batches, count: batches.length, total: list.length };
};

const writeBatchPick = function writeBatchPick(rows, indexRaw, size) {

  const index = indexRaw === undefined || indexRaw === null || indexRaw === "" ? 0 : Math.max(0, parseInt(String(indexRaw), 10) || 0);
  const part = list.slice(index * n, (index + 1) * n);
  return { rows: part, index: index, nextIndex: index + 1, count: part.length, from: index * n };

const sha256Hex = function sha256Hex(text) {
  const s = String(text);
  const bytes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    let c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff) {
      const d = i + 1 < s.length ? s.charCodeAt(i + 1) : 0;
      if (d >= 0xdc00 && d <= 0xdfff) {
        c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (d - 0xdc00);
        i++;
      } else c = 0xfffd;
    } else if (c >= 0xdc00 && c <= 0xdfff) c = 0xfffd;
    if (c < 0x80) bytes.push(c);
    else if (c < 0x800) bytes.push(0xc0 | (c >> 6), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else if (c < 0x10000) bytes.push(0xe0 | (c >> 12), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else bytes.push(0xf0 | (c >> 18), 0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 63), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
  }
  const K = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da, 0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
  ];
  const H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
  const bitLen = bytes.length * 8;
  bytes.push(0x80);
  while (bytes.length % 64 !== 56) bytes.push(0);
  const hi = Math.floor(bitLen / 0x100000000);
  const lo = bitLen >>> 0;
  bytes.push((hi >>> 24) & 255, (hi >>> 16) & 255, (hi >>> 8) & 255, hi & 255, (lo >>> 24) & 255, (lo >>> 16) & 255, (lo >>> 8) & 255, lo & 255);
  const rotr = (x, n) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
  const W = new Array(64);
  for (let off = 0; off < bytes.length; off += 64) {
    for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) W[t] = ((bytes[off + 4 * t] << 24) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 1] << 16) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 2] << 8) | bytes[off + 4 * t + 3]) >>> 0;
    for (let t = 16; t < 64; t++) {
      const s0 = rotr(W[t - 15], 7) ^ rotr(W[t - 15], 18) ^ (W[t - 15] >>> 3);
      const s1 = rotr(W[t - 2], 17) ^ rotr(W[t - 2], 19) ^ (W[t - 2] >>> 10);
      W[t] = (W[t - 16] + s0 + W[t - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3], e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];
    for (let t = 0; t < 64; t++) {
      const S1 = rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25);
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[t] + W[t]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22);
      const mj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const t2 = (S0 + mj) >>> 0;
      h = g;
      g = f;
      f = e;
      e = (d + t1) >>> 0;
      d = c;
      c = b;
      b = a;
      a = (t1 + t2) >>> 0;
    }
    H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
    H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
    H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
    H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
    H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
    H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
    H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
    H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
  }
  return H.map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")).join("");
};
const BALANCE_TYPES = CONTRACT.request.effect_fields.find((f) => f.name === "balance_type").values;
const DIRECTIONS = CONTRACT.request.effect_fields.find((f) => f.name === "direction").values;
const RESULT_CODES = CONTRACT.result_codes;
const PRE_MUTATION = CONTRACT.operation.pre_mutation;
const MUTATION_STARTED = CONTRACT.operation.mutation_started;
const DECISIONS = Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(CONTRACT.repeat_decision.decisions.map((d) => [d, d])));
const BALANCE_KEY_RE = new RegExp(CONTRACT.request.effect_fields.find((f) => f.name === "balance_key").pattern);
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
const SCALE = 8;
const DECIMAL_RE = /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d{1,8}))?$/;
function canonicalQuantity(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "number" && typeof value !== "string") return null;
  if (typeof value === "number" && !Number.isFinite(value)) return null;
  const m = String(value).trim().match(DECIMAL_RE);
  if (!m) return null;
  const units = toUnits(m[1], m[2] || "");
  return units > 0n ? fromUnits(units) : null;
}
function toUnits(intPart, fracPart) {
  return BigInt(intPart) * 10n ** BigInt(SCALE) + BigInt((fracPart || "").padEnd(SCALE, "0") || "0");
}
function quantityUnits(canonical) {
  const [i, f = ""] = canonical.split(".");
  return toUnits(i, f);
}
function fromUnits(units) {
  const base = 10n ** BigInt(SCALE);
  const i = units / base;
  const f = (units % base).toString().padStart(SCALE, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
  return f ? `${i}.${f}` : `${i}`;
}
function isBlank(v) {
  return v === undefined || v === null || (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() === "");
}
function validateEffect(effect, index) {
  const errors = [];
  const fail = (code, field) => errors.push({ code, field, index });
  for (const f of CONTRACT.request.effect_fields) {
    const v = effect ? effect[f.name] : undefined;
    if (f.required && isBlank(v)) {
      fail(f.name === "quantity_base" ? "QUANTITY_INVALID" : "REQUEST_INVALID", f.name);
      continue;
    }
    if (isBlank(v)) continue;
    if (f.max_length && typeof v === "string" && v.length > f.max_length) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", f.name);
  }
  if (!effect) return errors;
  if (!isBlank(effect.effect_key) && !/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,64}$/.test(String(effect.effect_key))) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "effect_key");
  if (!isBlank(effect.balance_type) && !BALANCE_TYPES.includes(effect.balance_type)) fail("BALANCE_TYPE_INVALID", "balance_type");
  if (!isBlank(effect.balance_key)) {
    const bk = String(effect.balance_key);
    if (!/^(ITEM|BATCH|HU|RESERVATION)\|/.test(bk) || bk.split("|")[0] !== effect.balance_type) fail("BALANCE_TYPE_INVALID", "balance_key");
    // The lock SQL interpolates balance keys as text (SQL nodes bind nothing, F10/F22):
    // only these characters are ever accepted.
    else if (!BALANCE_KEY_RE.test(bk)) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "balance_key");
  }
  if (!isBlank(effect.direction) && !DIRECTIONS.includes(effect.direction)) fail("DIRECTION_INVALID", "direction");
  if (!isBlank(effect.quantity_base) && canonicalQuantity(effect.quantity_base) === null) fail("QUANTITY_INVALID", "quantity_base");
  if (effect.balance_type === "BATCH" && isBlank(effect.batch_id)) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "batch_id");
  if (effect.balance_type === "HU" && isBlank(effect.hu_id)) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "hu_id");
  return errors;
}
function validateRequest(request) {
  const errors = [];
  if (!request || typeof request !== "object") return [{ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: null }];
  for (const f of CONTRACT.request.fields) {
    if (f.name === "effects" || f.name === "source_job_id") continue;
    const v = request[f.name];
    if (f.required && isBlank(v)) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: f.name });
    else if (!isBlank(v) && f.max_length && String(v).length > f.max_length) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: f.name });
  }
  if (!isBlank(request.operation_id) && !/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,64}$/.test(String(request.operation_id))) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "operation_id" });
  if (!isBlank(request.request_hash) && !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(String(request.request_hash))) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_HASH_INVALID", field: "request_hash" });
  if (request.source_job_id === undefined || request.source_job_id === null) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "source_job_id" });
  // Extension field (Task 5): a correction names the operation it corrects and is never that operation itself.
  if (!isBlank(request.original_operation_id)) {
    const orig = String(request.original_operation_id);
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,64}$/.test(orig) || orig === String(request.operation_id)) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "original_operation_id" });
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(request.effects) || request.effects.length === 0) {
    errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "effects" });
    return errors;
  }
  // One operation is one bounded mutation group (request.max_effects, the largest array size proven on the engine).
  // PROVISIONAL engine bound. One operation carries one whole business intent; it is never divided.
  if (request.effects.length > CONTRACT.request.max_effects) {
    return [{ code: "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE", field: "effects", effects: request.effects.length, max_effects: CONTRACT.request.max_effects }];
  }
  const seen = new Set();
  request.effects.forEach((e, i) => {
    errors.push(...validateEffect(e, i));
    if (e && !isBlank(e.effect_key)) {
      if (seen.has(e.effect_key)) errors.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_EFFECT_KEY", field: "effect_key", index: i });
      seen.add(e.effect_key);
    }
  });
  return errors;
}
function canonicalEffect(e) {
  const out = {};
  for (const f of CONTRACT.request.effect_fields) {
    const v = e[f.name];
    if (isBlank(v)) continue;
    out[f.name] = f.name === "quantity_base" ? canonicalQuantity(v) : v;
  }
  return out;
}
function computeRequestHash(request) {
  const body = {};
  for (const k of CONTRACT.request.hash.hashed_fields) {
    if (k === "effects") {
      body.effects = request.effects.map(canonicalEffect).sort((a, b) => cmp(a.effect_key, b.effect_key));
    } else {
      body[k] = request[k] === undefined || request[k] === null ? "" : String(request[k]);
    }
  }
  // Extension fields enter the hash only when present, so every hash computed before they existed stays valid.
  for (const k of CONTRACT.request.hash.hashed_when_present) if (!isBlank(request[k])) body[k] = String(request[k]);
  return sha256Hex(canonicalJson(body));
}
function cmp(a, b) {
  const x = a === undefined || a === null ? "" : String(a);
  const y = b === undefined || b === null ? "" : String(b);
  return x < y ? -1 : x > y ? 1 : 0;
}
function normalizeEffects(effects) {
  if (!Array.isArray(effects) || effects.length === 0) return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "effects" }] };
  const errors = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  effects.forEach((e, i) => {
    errors.push(...validateEffect(e, i));
    if (e && !isBlank(e.effect_key)) {
      if (seen.has(e.effect_key)) errors.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_EFFECT_KEY", field: "effect_key", index: i });
      seen.add(e.effect_key);
    }
  });
  if (errors.length) return { ok: false, errors };

  // The lock row's unique key is case-insensitive (utf8mb4_general_ci): two keys
  // that differ only by case would be one lock row claimed twice by one operation.
  const byUpper = new Map();
  for (const e of effects) {
    const u = String(e.balance_key).toUpperCase();
    if (byUpper.has(u) && byUpper.get(u) !== e.balance_key) {
      return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: "NORMALIZATION_CONFLICT", field: "balance_key", balance_key: e.balance_key }] };
    }
    byUpper.set(u, e.balance_key);
  }

  const uomByKey = new Map();
  for (const e of effects) {
    const prev = uomByKey.get(e.balance_key);
    if (prev !== undefined && prev !== e.uom_base) {
      return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: "NORMALIZATION_CONFLICT", field: "uom_base", balance_key: e.balance_key }] };
    }
    uomByKey.set(e.balance_key, e.uom_base);
  }

  const groups = new Map();
  for (const e of effects) {
    const c = canonicalEffect(e);
    const key = canonicalJson(CONTRACT.normalization.group_key.map((k) => (c[k] === undefined ? null : c[k])));
    const g = groups.get(key);
    if (!g) groups.set(key, { base: c, units: quantityUnits(c.quantity_base), keys: [c.effect_key] });
    else {
      g.units += quantityUnits(c.quantity_base);
      g.keys.push(c.effect_key);
    }
  }

  const out = [...groups.values()].map((g) => {
    const keys = [...g.keys].sort(cmp);
    return { ...g.base, effect_key: keys[0], quantity_base: fromUnits(g.units), merged_effect_keys: keys };
  });
  out.sort((a, b) => cmp(a.balance_key, b.balance_key) || cmp(a.stock_status, b.stock_status) || cmp(a.direction, b.direction) || cmp(a.movement_type, b.movement_type) || cmp(a.effect_key, b.effect_key));
  out.forEach((e, i) => {
    e.effect_sequence = i + 1;
  });
  return { ok: true, effects: out, lockKeys: lockOrder(out) };
}
function lockOrder(effects) {
  return [...new Set(effects.map((e) => e.balance_key))].sort(cmp);
}
function gateTaken(op) {
  return !!op && (op.gate_taken === true || (op.gate_taken !== null && op.gate_taken !== undefined && String(op.gate_taken).trim() === "1"));
}
function gateDecision(op) {
  if (!gateTaken(op)) return "";
  const owner = op.gate_owner === undefined || op.gate_owner === null ? "" : String(op.gate_owner).trim();
  if (owner.indexOf("REJECT|") === 0) return "REJECT";
  if (owner.indexOf("APPLY|") === 0) return "APPLY";
  return "UNKNOWN";
}
function gateRejectCode(op) {
  const parts = String(op && op.gate_owner ? op.gate_owner : "").split("|");
  const rc = RESULT_CODES[parts[1]];
  return rc && rc.response_status === "REJECTED" ? parts[1] : "STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION";
}
function mutationMayHaveStarted(op) {
  return !!op && (MUTATION_STARTED.includes(op.operation_status) || !isBlank(op.mutation_started_at) || (PRE_MUTATION.includes(op.operation_status) && gateTaken(op) && gateDecision(op) !== "REJECT"));
}
function isUncertain(op) {
  return !!op && op.operation_status !== "DONE" && mutationMayHaveStarted(op);
}
const DB_TIME_RE = /^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})(?:\.(\d{1,6}))?$/;
function dbTime(value) {
  const m = typeof value === "string" ? value.match(DB_TIME_RE) : null;
  if (!m) throw new Error(`not a DB column time 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS': ${String(value)}`);
  return `${m[1]}.${(m[2] || "").padEnd(6, "0")}`;
}
function leaseExpired(op, now) {
  if (isBlank(op.lease_expires_at)) return true;
  return dbTime(op.lease_expires_at) < dbTime(now);
}
function buildResponse(op, resultCode) {
  const code = resultCode || op.result_code;
  const rc = RESULT_CODES[code];
  if (!rc) throw new Error(`unknown result_code ${code}`);
  const res = {
    operation_id: op.operation_id,
    operation_status: rc.response_status,
    result_code: code,
    effect_summary: op.effect_summary || { effect_count: 0, lock_count: 0, by_status: {}, effects: [] },
  };
  if (rc.response_status === "REQUIRES_REVIEW") res.review_reference = op.review_reference || op.operation_id;
  return res;
}
function decideOnRepeat(stored, incoming, now) {
  if (!stored) return { decision: DECISIONS.PROCEED };
  if (stored.request_hash !== incoming.request_hash) {
    return { decision: DECISIONS.CONFLICT, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: incoming.operation_id }, "OPERATION_HASH_CONFLICT") };
  }
  // DONE first: a completed operation carries mutation_started_at by design.
  if (stored.operation_status === "DONE") {
    return { decision: DECISIONS.NOOP_RETURN_STORED, response: buildResponse(stored, "OK_REPLAYED") };
  }
  if (isUncertain(stored)) {
    // Never proceed. A live MUTATING/VERIFYING run is only waited for; a stale
    // one, an inconsistent row or REQUIRES_REVIEW answers REQUIRES_REVIEW.
    // A pre-mutation row whose APPLY gate was just taken (no mutation_started_at yet) is
    // as live as MUTATING while its lease holds.
    const gateDecided = PRE_MUTATION.includes(stored.operation_status) && gateTaken(stored) && isBlank(stored.mutation_started_at);
    const running = (["MUTATING", "VERIFYING"].includes(stored.operation_status) || gateDecided) && !leaseExpired(stored, now);
    if (running) return { decision: DECISIONS.IN_PROGRESS, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS") };
    const code = stored.operation_status === "REQUIRES_REVIEW" && stored.result_code ? stored.result_code : ["MUTATING", "VERIFYING"].includes(stored.operation_status) ? "STALE_AFTER_MUTATION_STARTED" : "OPERATION_UNDER_REVIEW";
    return { decision: DECISIONS.NOT_RETRYABLE, response: buildResponse(stored, code) };
  }
  const rejectGate = gateDecision(stored) === "REJECT";
  const live = !leaseExpired(stored, now);
  if (stored.operation_status === "REJECTED" && (!rejectGate || live)) {
    return { decision: DECISIONS.NOOP_RETURN_STORED, response: buildResponse(stored) };
  }
  if (rejectGate) {
    if (live) return { decision: DECISIONS.IN_PROGRESS, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS") };
    const code = stored.operation_status === "REJECTED" && stored.result_code ? stored.result_code : gateRejectCode(stored);
    return { decision: DECISIONS.RECOVER, finish: true, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id, effect_summary: stored.effect_summary }, code) };
  }
  if (PRE_MUTATION.includes(stored.operation_status)) {
    if (live) return { decision: DECISIONS.IN_PROGRESS, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS") };
    const code = stored.operation_status === "LOCKING" ? "LOCK_CONFLICT" : "STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION";
    return { decision: DECISIONS.RECOVER, finish: false, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, code) };
  }
  throw new Error(`unknown operation_status ${stored.operation_status}`);
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
