const dec8 = function dec8() {
  const S = 100000000n;
  const parse = (v) => {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) return null;
    const m = String(v).trim().match(/^(-)?([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]+))?$/);
    if (!m) return null;
    const frac = m[3] || "";
    if (frac.length > 8 && /[1-9]/.test(frac.slice(8))) return null;
    const u = BigInt(m[2]) * S + BigInt((frac.slice(0, 8) + "00000000").slice(0, 8));
    return m[1] ? -u : u;
  };
  const fmt = (u) => {
    const neg = u < 0n;
    const a = neg ? -u : u;
    const f = (a % S).toString().padStart(8, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
    return (neg ? "-" : "") + (a / S).toString() + (f ? "." + f : "");
  };
  const mul = (a, b) => {
    const p = a * b;
    const neg = p < 0n;
    const q = ((neg ? -p : p) + S / 2n) / S;
    return neg ? -q : q;
  };
  const same = (a, b) => {
    const x = parse(a);
    const y = parse(b);
    return x !== null && y !== null && x === y;
  };
  return { S: S, parse: parse, fmt: fmt, mul: mul, same: same };
};
const withAutoAllocation = function withAutoAllocation(parse, alloc) {
  const a = alloc || {};
  const by = {};
  for (const r of Array.isArray(a.autoRows) ? a.autoRows : []) by[r.i] = r;
  const lines = (Array.isArray(parse.lines) ? parse.lines : []).map((l, i) => (by[i] ? Object.assign({}, l, { allocations: by[i].allocations, raw: Object.assign({}, l.raw || {}, by[i].patch), auto_allocated: 1 }) : l));
  return Object.assign({}, parse, { lines: lines, autoErrors: Array.isArray(a.autoErrors) ? a.autoErrors : [], locationIdsSql: a.locationIdsSql || parse.locationIdsSql, tuplesSql: a.tuplesSql || parse.tuplesSql, pickingRequired: String(a.pickingRequired) === "1" ? 1 : 0 });
};
const prepareValidate = function prepareValidate(guard, parse, reads) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const arr = (x) => (Array.isArray(x) ? x : x ? [x] : []).filter((r) => r && !(r.id === null && r.kind === undefined && r.material_id === undefined));
  const D = dec8();
  const R = reads || {};
  const jobId = parse.jobId;
  const org = parse.organizationId;
  const plant = parse.plantId;
  const header = parse.header || {};
  const deliveryNo = s(header.delivery_no);
  const errors = [];
  const err = (line, field, code, message, seq) => errors.push({ line_no: line ? line.line_no : null, stable_line_key: line ? line.stable_line_key : "", allocation_sequence: seq === undefined ? null : seq, field: field, code: code, message: message });
  // the auto allocation's refusals (prepareAutoAllocate: the old save stops the whole save on the first)
  for (const e of Array.isArray(parse.autoErrors) ? parse.autoErrors : []) errors.push(e);
  // ---- master maps
  const items = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.items)) if (s(r.id)) items[s(r.id)] = r;
  const conv = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.uoms)) {
    if (String(r.is_deleted) !== "0") continue;
    const k = s(r.item_id) + "|" + s(r.alt_uom_id);
    if (!conv[k]) conv[k] = [];
    conv[k].push(r);
  }
  const bins = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.bins)) if (s(r.id)) bins[s(r.id)] = r;
  const bal = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.balances)) {
    if (!s(r.id)) continue;
    const k = s(r.material_id) + "," + s(r.location_id);
    if (!bal[k]) bal[k] = [];
    bal[k].push(r);
  }
  // blockers: SERIAL_ROWS per (material, bin); BATCH_ROWS per (material, bin, batch) with the batch row's Unrestricted
  // (a non-batch material with batch rows at the bin is refused; a batch material is checked on its batch row - D-1)
  const blockers = {};
  const batchRows = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.blockers)) {
    if (!s(r.kind)) continue;
    const k = s(r.kind) + "|" + s(r.material_id) + "|" + s(r.location_id);
    blockers[k] = (blockers[k] || 0) + (Number(r.n) || 0);
    if (s(r.kind) === "BATCH_ROWS") batchRows[s(r.material_id) + "," + s(r.location_id) + "," + s(r.batch_id)] = { n: Number(r.n) || 0, qty: s(r.qty) };
  }
  // the costing method -> costing_context.method; FIFO and Weighted Average are priced by the inventory operation under
  // its lock (D-5: the price the frozen SUBTRACT stamps on a reservation; no costing row is written)
  const METHOD = { "Fixed Cost": "FIXED_COST", "First In First Out": "FIFO", "Weighted Average": "WEIGHTED_AVERAGE" };
  const sos = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.sos)) if (s(r.id)) sos[s(r.id)] = r;
  const soLines = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.soLines)) if (s(r.id)) soLines[s(r.id)] = r;
  const pending = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.pending)) if (s(r.parent_line_id)) pending[s(r.parent_line_id)] = (pending[s(r.parent_line_id)] || 0) + 1;
  // quantity already committed by OTHER hidden (Processing) deliveries, per sales order line (fail-closed: counted as delivered)
  const hidden = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.hidden)) if (s(r.so_line_id)) hidden[s(r.so_line_id)] = D.parse(r.qty) || 0n;
  const soProjection = [];
  // packing: the organization's packing setup (plant row first, else the organization row) and its Packing serial rule
  const setups = arr(R.packing).filter((r) => s(r.id) && String(r.is_deleted) === "0");
  const setup = setups.filter((r) => s(r.plant_id) === plant)[0] || setups.filter((r) => !s(r.plant_id) || s(r.plant_id) === "0" || s(r.plant_id) === "null")[0] || setups[0] || null;
  const rules = arr(R.rules).filter((r) => s(r.id) && String(r.is_deleted) === "0").sort((a, b) => (Number(b.is_default) || 0) - (Number(a.is_default) || 0) || (Number(a.is_draft) || 0) - (Number(b.is_draft) || 0) || (s(a.id) < s(b.id) ? -1 : 1));
  const packingRequired = setup && String(setup.packing_required) === "1" ? 1 : 0;
  const mode = s(header.allocation_mode) || "RESERVE";
  if (["RESERVE", "ITEM_ONLY"].indexOf(mode) < 0) errors.push({ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", allocation_sequence: null, field: "allocation_mode", code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", message: "allocation_mode: RESERVE or ITEM_ONLY" });
  else if (mode === "ITEM_ONLY" && org !== "0") errors.push({ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", allocation_sequence: null, field: "allocation_mode", code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", message: "allocation_mode ITEM_ONLY is the organization-0 test shape only" });
  if (packingRequired && !rules.length) errors.push({ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", allocation_sequence: null, field: "packing", code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", message: "packing is required by the packing setup but the organization has no Packing serial-number rule" });
  // the document number: any goods_delivery row (live or soft-deleted: the unique index keeps a deleted row's key) with
  // this organization's delivery_no makes the delivery unpublishable (fix round 1, I1)
  // (OI4: a delivery numbered on insert - "issued" - has no number to check yet; the rule issues a fresh one)
  const docRows = deliveryNo === "issued" ? [] : arr(R.docno).filter((r) => s(r.id));
  if (docRows.length) errors.push({ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", allocation_sequence: null, field: "delivery_no", code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", message: "document number " + deliveryNo + " already used by goods delivery " + s(docRows[0].id) + (String(docRows[0].is_deleted) === "0" ? "" : " (deleted; the number stays occupied)") });
  const stageById = {};
  const stageByKey = {};
  for (const r of arr(R.stage)) {
    if (!s(r.id)) continue;
    stageById[s(r.id)] = r;
    stageByKey[s(r.stable_line_key) + "|" + s(r.allocation_sequence)] = r;
  }
  // ---- per line
  const outSum = {};
  const effects = [];
  const stageRows = [];
  const reservations = [];
  const lines = [];
  const confirmations = {};
  const docDate = s(header.delivery_date);
  const headerSoNo = s(header.so_no);
  // item bundles (decided 2026-10-03, B-2 / B-3): the bundle row of each item, by the item's parent_key
  const lineByKey = {};
  for (const l0 of parse.lines) lineByKey[l0.stable_line_key] = l0;
  for (const line of parse.lines) {
    // The item bundle row (kind BUNDLE): no material, nothing delivered against it - no item / unit / stock check, no
    // effect, no reservation, no sales order projection (the old save leaves the bundle's sales order line untouched on
    // Created: code_node_QtyCheckBatch updates it only when saveAs === "Completed"). What the old save does check on it
    // (code_node_IyJHrBst, the descriptive-line branch): a description. V2's own structural checks: its sales order
    // line is a bundle line of the same order (and its items' lines hang under it, below).
    if (line.kind === "BUNDLE") {
      const braw = line.raw || {};
      let bOk = true;
      if (!s(braw.material_name) && !s(braw.gd_material_desc)) {
        err(line, "material_name", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "row has no material_id and no description");
        bOk = false;
      }
      if (line.so_line_id) {
        const bsl = soLines[line.so_line_id];
        if (!bsl || String(bsl.is_deleted) !== "0" || s(bsl.sales_order_id) !== line.so_id) {
          err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line " + line.so_line_id + " not found on sales order " + line.so_id);
          bOk = false;
        } else if (!s(bsl.item_bundle_id) || s(bsl.material_id)) {
          err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line " + line.so_line_id + " is not an item bundle line");
          bOk = false;
        } else if (s(bsl.item_bundle_id) !== s(line.item_bundle_id)) {
          err(line, "item_bundle_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "item bundle " + s(line.item_bundle_id) + " differs from the sales order line's bundle " + s(bsl.item_bundle_id));
          bOk = false;
        }
      }
      lines.push({ line: line, it: null, ok: bOk, baseUom: "", baseQty: line.quantity, allocs: [], bundle: true });
      continue;
    }
    const bundleRow = line.parent_key ? lineByKey[line.parent_key] : null;
    // a bundle is delivered as a whole (code_node_IyJHrBst bundleRatioProblem): an item's quantity is its ordered
    // quantity per bundle times the number of bundles delivered - expected = item.gd_order_quantity /
    // bundle.gd_order_quantity x bundle.gd_qty, refused when |gd_qty - expected| > 0.001; no check when the bundle's
    // ordered quantity is not > 0. Compared exactly: |q x O - o x Q| > 0.001 x O (q / o the item's delivered /
    // ordered, Q / O the bundle's).
    if (bundleRow && bundleRow.kind === "BUNDLE") {
      const O = D.parse(s((bundleRow.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) || 0n;
      if (O > 0n) {
        const Q = D.parse(bundleRow.quantity) || 0n;
        const o = D.parse(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) || 0n;
        const q = D.parse(line.quantity) || 0n;
        const gap = q * O - o * Q;
        if ((gap < 0n ? -gap : gap) > 100000n * O) {
          const expected = ((parseFloat(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) || 0) / (parseFloat(s((bundleRow.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) || 0)) * (parseFloat(bundleRow.quantity) || 0);
          err(line, "gd_qty", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "item bundle quantities must stay in proportion - expected " + expected.toFixed(3) + ", got " + (parseFloat(line.quantity) || 0).toFixed(3) + ". Deliver an item bundle by its bundle line - its items follow from it and cannot be delivered on their own.");
        }
      }
    }
    const it = items[line.material_id];
    const lineIdx = line.line_no;
    let lineOk = true;
    if (!it || String(it.is_deleted) !== "0") {
      err(line, "material_id", "GD_INVALID_ITEM", "material " + line.material_id + " not found in organization " + org + " or deleted");
      lineOk = false;
    } else {
      if (String(it.stock_control) !== "1") {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "material is not stock-controlled");
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (!METHOD[s(it.material_costing_method)]) {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "costing method '" + s(it.material_costing_method) + "' is not supported by the V2 inventory path (Fixed Cost, First In First Out or Weighted Average; inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)");
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (["0", "1"].indexOf(String(it.item_batch_management)) < 0) {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "item_batch_management is " + String(it.item_batch_management) + " (0 or 1 expected)");
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (String(it.serial_number_management) !== "0") {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "serial-managed material is not supported by the V2 inventory path yet (inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)");
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (s(it.material_costing_method) === "Fixed Cost" && (D.parse(it.purchase_unit_price) === null || D.parse(it.purchase_unit_price) < 0n)) {
        err(line, "material_id", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "purchase_unit_price is empty or unreadable (Fixed Cost price)");
        lineOk = false;
      }
    }
    // unit of measure -> base
    let factorNum = 1n;
    let factorDen = 1n;
    const baseUom = it ? s(it.based_uom) : "";
    if (it && lineOk) {
      if (line.uom_id !== baseUom) {
        const rows = conv[line.material_id + "|" + line.uom_id] || [];
        if (rows.length !== 1) {
          err(line, "gd_order_uom_id", "GD_INVALID_UOM", rows.length ? "several conversions for this unit" : "unit " + line.uom_id + " has no conversion to the base unit of the material");
          lineOk = false;
        } else {
          const bq = D.parse(rows[0].base_qty);
          const aq = D.parse(rows[0].alt_qty);
          if (bq === null || aq === null || bq <= 0n || aq <= 0n || s(rows[0].base_uom_id) !== baseUom) {
            err(line, "gd_order_uom_id", "GD_INVALID_UOM", "conversion row is unusable (base_qty / alt_qty / base_uom_id)");
            lineOk = false;
          } else {
            factorNum = bq;
            factorDen = aq;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const qtyUnits = D.parse(line.quantity);
    if (qtyUnits === null || qtyUnits < 0n) {
      err(line, "gd_qty", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "gd_qty unreadable");
      lineOk = false;
    }
    if (qtyUnits === 0n || !line.allocations.length) confirmations.ZERO_QUANTITY = true;
    if (s((line.raw || {}).line_pp_id) || s((line.raw || {}).pp_line_item_id)) {
      err(line, "line_pp_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "picking-plan-linked lines are not supported by the V2 path yet");
      lineOk = false;
    }
    // sales order state (only when the line names one)
    if (line.so_id) {
      const so = sos[line.so_id];
      if (!so || String(so.is_deleted) !== "0") {
        err(line, "line_so_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order " + line.so_id + " not found");
        lineOk = false;
      } else if (["Cancelled", "Completed", "Closed"].indexOf(s(so.so_status)) >= 0) {
        err(line, "line_so_id", "GD_SO_CLOSED", "sales order is " + s(so.so_status));
        lineOk = false;
      }
      if (line.so_line_id) {
        const sl = soLines[line.so_line_id];
        if (!sl || String(sl.is_deleted) !== "0" || s(sl.sales_order_id) !== line.so_id) {
          err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line " + line.so_line_id + " not found on sales order " + line.so_id);
          lineOk = false;
        } else {
          if (s(sl.material_id) && s(sl.material_id) !== line.material_id) {
            err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line is for another material");
            lineOk = false;
          }
          // an item of a bundle delivers an item line of the bundle's own sales order line (sales_order_axszx8cj_sub:
          // an item line's parent_id is its bundle line)
          if (bundleRow && bundleRow.kind === "BUNDLE" && bundleRow.so_line_id && s(sl.parent_id) !== bundleRow.so_line_id) {
            err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "sales order line " + line.so_line_id + " is not an item of the bundle's sales order line " + bundleRow.so_line_id);
            lineOk = false;
          }
          if (["Cancelled", "Completed"].indexOf(s(sl.line_status)) >= 0) {
            err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_SO_CLOSED", "sales order line is " + s(sl.line_status));
            lineOk = false;
          }
          if (pending[line.so_line_id]) {
            err(line, "so_line_item_id", "GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED", "the sales order line carries a pending reservation (on_reserved_gd Pending): the old save allocates from it first; consuming a pending reservation is not implemented by the V2 path");
            lineOk = false;
          }
          // over-delivery (gd_workflow.json code_node_QtyCheckBatch, a new delivery saved as Created): delivered + planned
          // + this delivery must not exceed the ordered quantity plus the unit's over-delivery tolerance; hidden
          // deliveries of other jobs count as committed (ruling D-R6)
          const ordered = D.parse(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) !== null && D.parse(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) > 0n ? D.parse(s((line.raw || {}).gd_order_quantity)) : D.parse(sl.so_quantity) || 0n;
          const tolRows = conv[line.material_id + "|" + line.uom_id] || [];
          const tolUnits = tolRows.length === 1 ? D.parse(tolRows[0].over_delivery_tolerance) || 0n : D.parse((it || {}).over_delivery_tolerance) || 0n;
          const limit = (ordered * (100n * D.S + tolUnits)) / (100n * D.S);
          const committed = (D.parse(sl.delivered_qty) || 0n) + (D.parse(sl.planned_qty) || 0n) + (hidden[line.so_line_id] || 0n) + (qtyUnits || 0n);
          if (committed > limit) {
            err(line, "gd_qty", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "quantity is exceeding the maximum deliverable quantity (delivered " + D.fmt(D.parse(sl.delivered_qty) || 0n) + " + planned " + D.fmt(D.parse(sl.planned_qty) || 0n) + " + processing " + D.fmt(hidden[line.so_line_id] || 0n) + " + this " + D.fmt(qtyUnits || 0n) + " > " + D.fmt(limit) + ")");
            lineOk = false;
          } else if (qtyUnits !== null && qtyUnits > 0n) soProjection.push({ so_line_id: line.so_line_id, so_id: line.so_id, delta: D.fmt(qtyUnits), limit: D.fmt(limit) });
        }
      }
    }
    // allocations -> effects
    const base8 = (u) => D.fmt((u * factorNum + factorDen / 2n) / factorDen);
    const lineBaseUnits = qtyUnits === null ? 0n : (qtyUnits * factorNum + factorDen / 2n) / factorDen;
    const allocOut = [];
    const isBatch = !!it && String(it.item_batch_management) === "1";
    for (const a of line.allocations) {
      const seq = a.allocation_sequence;
      let aOk = lineOk;
      if (a.hu_id) {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "allocation " + seq + ": handling-unit stock is not supported by the V2 inventory path yet (inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)", seq);
        aOk = false;
      }
      if (it && lineOk && isBatch && !/^[0-9]{1,19}$/.test(s(a.batch_id))) {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": the material is batch-managed: the allocation needs its batch (select the batch in Select Stock)", seq);
        aOk = false;
      }
      if (it && lineOk && !isBatch && s(a.batch_id)) {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": the material is not batch-managed, the allocation names batch " + s(a.batch_id), seq);
        aOk = false;
      }
      const bin = bins[a.location_id];
      if (!bin || String(bin.is_deleted) !== "0") {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": bin " + a.location_id + " not found", seq);
        aOk = false;
      } else if (s(bin.plant_id) !== plant || s(bin.organization_id) !== org) {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": bin " + a.location_id + " belongs to another plant or organization", seq);
        aOk = false;
      } else if (String(bin.bin_status) !== "1") {
        err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": bin " + a.location_id + " is inactive", seq);
        aOk = false;
      }
      const au = D.parse(a.quantity);
      const baseQty = au === null ? "0" : base8(au);
      const tupleKey = line.material_id + "," + a.location_id;
      // the bucket the sufficiency check sums: the item row, or for a batch material its batch row (the frozen SUBTRACT
      // checks the batch row only, legacy-costing-batch-spec.md 7.1)
      const stockKey = isBatch ? tupleKey + "," + s(a.batch_id) : tupleKey;
      if (aOk && it) {
        const rows = bal[tupleKey] || [];
        if (rows.length !== 1) {
          err(line, "temp_qty_data", rows.length ? "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED" : "GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "allocation " + seq + ": " + (rows.length ? rows.length + " item_balance rows for the material at this bin (inventory BALANCE_STATE_INVALID)" : "no stock balance for the material at bin " + a.location_id), seq);
          aOk = false;
        } else if (s(rows[0].material_uom) && s(rows[0].material_uom) !== baseUom) {
          err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "allocation " + seq + ": the balance row's unit differs from the material's base unit", seq);
          aOk = false;
        }
        if (isBatch) {
          const br = batchRows[stockKey];
          if (!br || br.n !== 1) {
            err(line, "temp_qty_data", br ? "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED" : "GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "allocation " + seq + ": " + (br ? br.n + " item_batch_balance rows for batch " + s(a.batch_id) + " at this bin (inventory BALANCE_STATE_INVALID)" : "no stock of batch " + s(a.batch_id) + " at bin " + a.location_id), seq);
            aOk = false;
          }
        } else if (blockers["BATCH_ROWS|" + line.material_id + "|" + a.location_id]) {
          err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "allocation " + seq + ": batch balance rows exist at this bin for a material that is not batch-managed (inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)", seq);
          aOk = false;
        }
        if (blockers["SERIAL_ROWS|" + line.material_id + "|" + a.location_id]) {
          err(line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED", "allocation " + seq + ": serial balance rows exist at this bin (inventory EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED)", seq);
          aOk = false;
        }
      }
      if (aOk) {
        if (!outSum[stockKey]) outSum[stockKey] = 0n;
        outSum[stockKey] += D.parse(baseQty);
      }
      allocOut.push({ seq: seq, a: a, ok: aOk, baseQty: baseQty, tupleKey: stockKey, isBatch: isBatch });
    }
    lines.push({ line: line, it: it, ok: lineOk, baseUom: baseUom, baseQty: D.fmt(lineBaseUnits), allocs: allocOut });
  }
  // aggregate sufficiency, read-only (the inventory operation re-checks under its locks)
  for (const k of Object.keys(outSum)) {
    const parts = k.split(",");
    const row = parts.length === 3 ? (batchRows[k] ? { unrestricted_qty: batchRows[k].qty } : null) : (bal[k] || [])[0];
    const have = row ? (s(row.unrestricted_qty) === "" ? 0n : D.parse(row.unrestricted_qty)) : null;
    if (have === null || have < outSum[k]) {
      for (const L of lines) for (const A of L.allocs) if (A.ok && A.tupleKey === k) {
        A.ok = false;
        err(L.line, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "allocation " + A.seq + ": unrestricted stock " + (have === null ? "0" : D.fmt(have)) + " at bin " + A.a.location_id + (parts.length === 3 ? " (batch " + parts[2] + ")" : "") + " is less than the " + D.fmt(outSum[k]) + " requested by this delivery", A.seq);
      }
    }
  }
  // effects, stage rows, reservation rows (deterministic order: line, allocation)
  let effectCount = 0;
  for (const L of lines) {
    const line = L.line;
    // the item bundle row: ONE stage row (B-4: allocation 0, strategy BUNDLE, no material, no effect; its parent link is
    // in its items' keys L<i>.<j>), so P2's gd_line_id stamping stays uniform
    if (L.bundle) {
      const eb = errors.filter((e) => e.stable_line_key === line.stable_line_key)[0];
      stageRows.push({ job_id: jobId, organization_id: org, stable_line_key: line.stable_line_key, allocation_sequence: 0, payload_hash: parse.payloadHash, gd_line_index: line.line_no, so_id: line.so_id || "", so_line_id: line.so_line_id || "", material_id: "", material_code: "", uom_id: line.uom_id, base_uom_id: "", requested_qty: line.quantity, base_qty: line.quantity, plant_id: plant, location_id: "", batch_id: "", hu_id: "", allocation_strategy: "BUNDLE", effect_key_out: "", effect_key_in: "", picking_projection: "", costing_input: "", line_status: eb ? "INVALID" : "VALID", error_code: eb ? eb.code : "", error_message: eb ? eb.message : "" });
      continue;
    }
    const it = L.it || {};
    const method = L.it ? METHOD[s(it.material_costing_method)] || "FIXED_COST" : "FIXED_COST";
    const cc = { method: method, trx_no: deliveryNo, doc_date: docDate };
    // a Fixed Cost price is the master's; FIFO / Weighted Average are priced by the inventory operation under its lock
    if (method === "FIXED_COST") cc.unit_price = L.it && D.parse(it.purchase_unit_price) !== null ? D.fmt(D.parse(it.purchase_unit_price)) : "0";
    const parentNo = line.so_no || headerSoNo;
    if (parentNo) cc.parent_trx_no = parentNo;
    const lineErrors = errors.filter((e) => e.stable_line_key === line.stable_line_key);
    if (!L.allocs.length) {
      const e0 = lineErrors.filter((e) => e.allocation_sequence === null)[0];
      stageRows.push({ job_id: jobId, organization_id: org, stable_line_key: line.stable_line_key, allocation_sequence: 0, payload_hash: parse.payloadHash, gd_line_index: line.line_no, so_id: line.so_id || "", so_line_id: line.so_line_id || "", material_id: line.material_id, material_code: s(it.material_code), uom_id: line.uom_id, base_uom_id: L.baseUom, requested_qty: line.quantity, base_qty: L.baseQty, plant_id: plant, location_id: "", batch_id: "", hu_id: "", allocation_strategy: "NONE", effect_key_out: "", effect_key_in: "", picking_projection: "", costing_input: "", line_status: e0 ?     }
    for (const A of L.allocs) {
      const a = A.a;
      const seq = A.seq;
      // a batch material moves its batch row (and, inside the inventory operation, the item aggregate row): BATCH effects
      const type = A.isBatch ? "BATCH" : "ITEM";
      const keyOut = line.line_no + "." + seq + "." + type + ".OUT";
      const keyIn = line.line_no + "." + seq + "." + type + ".IN";
      const bk = A.isBatch ? "BATCH|" + line.material_id + "|" + a.location_id + "|" + s(a.batch_id) : "ITEM|" + line.material_id + "|" + a.location_id;
      const bx = A.isBatch ? { batch_id: s(a.batch_id) } : {};

      const ok = A.ok && !aErr;
      if (ok) {
        effects.push(Object.assign({ effect_key: keyOut, balance_type: type, balance_key: bk, direction: "OUT", quantity_base: A.baseQty, uom_base: L.baseUom, stock_status: "Unrestricted", movement_type: GDC.movement_type, costing_context: cc }, bx));
        effects.push(Object.assign({ effect_key: keyIn, balance_type: type, balance_key: bk, direction: "IN", quantity_base: A.baseQty, uom_base: L.baseUom, stock_status: "Reserved", movement_type: GDC.movement_type, costing_context: cc }, bx));
        effectCount += mode === "RESERVE" ? 3 : 2; // + the RESERVATION IN of the hidden reservation row (D-4)
        if (mode === "RESERVE") reservations.push({ doc_type: "Good Delivery", status: GDC.res_hidden, parent_id: line.so_id || null, parent_line_id: line.so_line_id || null, parent_no: parentNo || null, doc_no: deliveryNo, doc_id: "", doc_line_id: "", material_id: line.material_id, item_code: s(it.material_code), item_name: s(it.material_name), item_desc: s(it.material_desc), batch_id: A.isBatch ? s(a.batch_id) : null, bin_location: a.location_id, item_uom: line.uom_id, reserved_qty: a.quantity, delivered_qty: "0", open_qty: a.quantity, reserved_date: docDate, line_no: line.line_no, plant_id: plant, organization_id: org, remark: null, target_gd_id: "", source_reserved_id: null, handling_unit_id: null, job_line_key: jobId + "|" + line.stable_line_key + "|" + seq, stable_line_key: line.stable_line_key, allocation_sequence: seq });
      }
      stageRows.push({ job_id: jobId, organization_id: org, stable_line_key: line.stable_line_key, allocation_sequence: seq, payload_hash: parse.payloadHash, gd_line_index: line.line_no, so_id: line.so_id || "", so_line_id: line.so_line_id || "", material_id: line.material_id, material_code: s(it.material_code), uom_id: line.uom_id, base_uom_id: L.baseUom, requested_qty: a.quantity, base_qty: A.baseQty, plant_id: plant, location_id: a.location_id, batch_id: a.batch_id || "", hu_id: a.hu_id || "", allocation_strategy: "UNRESTRICTED_TO_RESERVED", effect_key_out: ok ? keyOut : "", effect_key_in: ok ? keyIn : "", picking_projection: "", costing_input: ok ? canonicalJson(Object.assign({ balance_type: type, balance_key: bk, uom_base: L.baseUom, stock_out: "Unrestricted", stock_in: "Reserved", movement_type: GDC.movement_type, costing_context: cc }, bx)) : "", line_status: ok ? "VALID" : "INVALID", error_code: aErr ? aErr.code : "", error_message: aErr ? aErr.message : "" });
    }
  }
  const thousands = (x) => String(x).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
  if (effectCount > GDC.max_effects) err(null, "lines", "GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS", "This delivery is too large for one save: after stock allocation it needs " + thousands(effectCount) + " inventory effects and one save can carry at most " + thousands(Math.floor(GDC.max_effects / 3)) + " stock allocations (" + thousands(GDC.max_effects) + " inventory effects).   const confirmed = !needed.length || confirmationHash === parse.confirmationHash;

  const stageAddRows = [];

  // an item bundle row and its items included - carries the header values the old save copies onto each surviving row

  const stampHeader = (out) => {
    out.customer_id = header.customer_name || null;
    out.organization_id = org;
    out.plant_id = plant || null;
    out.billing_state_id = header.billing_address_state || null;
    out.billing_country_id = header.billing_address_country || null;
    out.shipping_state_id = header.shipping_address_state || null;
    out.shipping_country_id = header.shipping_address_country || null;
    out.assigned_to = header.assigned_to || null;
    out.area_id = header.gd_area_id || null;

  };

  // from a Picking): picking_status "Completed" when the organization's setup requires picking (gdSetup
  // picking_required = 1) and the header has no picking_status yet; packing_status "Completed"
  const fromPicking = String(header.is_select_picking) === "1";
  const bundlePicking = parse.pickingRequired === 1 && !fromPicking && !s(header.picking_status);
  const gdFlat = lines.map((L) => {
    const line = L.line;
    const raw = line.raw || {};
    const out = {};
    for (const k of Object.keys(raw)) if (k !== "stable_line_key" && k !== "allocations" && k !== "children") out[k] = raw[k];
    if (L.bundle) {
      stampHeader(out);
      out.material_id = "";
      out.item_bundle_id = line.item_bundle_id;
      out.gd_qty = line.quantity;
      out.line_index = line.line_index;
      out.job_line_key = jobId + "|" + line.stable_line_key + "|0";
      out.temp_qty_data = "[]";
      if (bundlePicking) out.picking_status = "Completed";
      if (!fromPicking) out.packing_status = "Completed";
      if (raw.line_so_id !== undefined) out.line_so_id = line.so_id || null;
      if (raw.so_line_item_id !== undefined) out.so_line_item_id = line.so_line_id || null;

    }

  });
  // the TREE the old save's "Add GD Data" (add_node_ROqbYEI6) inserts: each item under its bundle row's `children`
  // (the engine stores the bundle row, then each item with parent_id = the bundle row's id: survey section 3)
  const gdLines = [];
  const topByKey = {};
  for (const g of gdFlat) {
    const top = g.parent ? topByKey[g.parent] : null;
    if (top) {
      if (!Array.isArray(top.children)) top.children = [];
      top.children.push(g.row);
    } else {
      gdLines.push(g.row);
      topByKey[g.key] = g.row;
    }
  }
  const hdr = {};
  for (const k of GDC.header_fields) hdr[k] = header[k] === undefined ? null : header[k];
  hdr.organization_id = org;
  hdr.plant_id = plant;
  const soIds = Array.isArray(header.so_id) ? header.so_id.map((x) => s(x)) : [];

  // the correlation the inventory operation, the outbox event and its consumption carry: their columns hold 64
  // characters (inventory request.fields max_length 64); a form key of a real organization is longer
  // (GDF:<19-digit org>:<number>:<16 hex>:<16 hex>:<gen>, 71+ characters; pass 10101 job 2105847292639522817 was
  // REQUEST_INVALID correlation_id), so it is replaced by the job id - the job row keeps the full key
  const corrJob = s(parse.correlationId);
  const corrDown = corrJob && corrJob.length <= 64 && /^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]+$/.test(corrJob) ? corrJob : "GDJOB:" + jobId;

"ENGINE_TEST" : "GOODS_DELIVERY", source_job_id: jobId, correlation_id: corrDown, requested_by: parse.requestedBy }, event: { picking_required: 1, source_so_ids: soIds, line_count: lines.length } };
  const first = errors[0];
  let route = "OK";
  if (errors.length) route = "FAIL";
  else if (!confirmed) route = "CONFIRM";
  return {
    route: route,
    errors: errors,
    effects: effects,
    effectCount: effects.length,
    stageRows: stageRows,
    stageAddRows: stageAddRows,
    stageUpdRows: stageUpdRows,
    needStageAdd: stageAddRows.length ? "YES" : "NO",
    needStageUpd: stageUpdRows.length ? "YES" : "NO",
    stageExpected: stageRows.length,
    prepared: prepared,
    preparedText: canonicalJson(prepared),
    requiredConfirmations: needed,
    confirmationHash: confirmationHash,
    result_code: first ? first.code : route === "CONFIRM" ? "GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY" : "",
    result_message: first ? first.message : route === "CONFIRM" ? "confirmation needed: " + needed.join(", ") : "",
  };
};
const prepareFinish = function prepareFinish(guard, parse, val, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const fin = (o) => Object.assign({ job_id: guard.jobId, line_count: String(val.prepared.line_count), effect_count: String(val.prepared.effect_count), stage_count: String(o.stageCount) }, o);
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id));
  const byKey = {};
  for (const r of list) byKey[s(r.stable_line_key) + "|" + s(r.allocation_sequence)] = r;
  const missing = val.stageRows.filter((r) => !byKey[r.stable_line_key + "|" + r.allocation_sequence]);
  const now = parse.dbNow;
  const base = parse.jobRows[0];
  const row = (st, patch) => Object.assign({}, base, { job_status: st, progress_message: GDC.display[st] || st, progress_percent: Math.max(Number(base.progress_percent) || 0, GDC.progress[st] === null || GDC.progress[st] === undefined ? 0 : GDC.progress[st]), row_version: parse.rowVersion + 2 }, patch || {});
  if (missing.length || list.length !== val.stageExpected) {
    const msg = "stage rows: expected " + val.stageExpected + ", found " + list.length + (missing.length ? ", missing " + missing.slice(0, 5).map((r) => r.stable_line_key + "|" + r.allocation_sequence).join(" ") : "");
    return fin({ route: "FAIL", jobRows: [row("FAILED", { error_code: "GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", error_message: msg, error_details: canonicalJson({ line_errors: [{ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", field: "gd_bulk_line_stage", code: "GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", message: msg }] }), finished_at: now })], result_code: "GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", result_message: msg, job_status: "FAILED", stageCount: list.length });
  }
  if (val.route === "FAIL") {
    const first = val.errors[0];
    return fin({ route: "FAIL", jobRows: [row("FAILED", { error_code: first.code, error_message: first.message, error_details: canonicalJson({ line_errors: val.errors.slice(0, 500), staging_hash: val.prepared.staging_hash }), finished_at: now, line_count: val.prepared.line_count })], result_code: first.code, result_message: first.message, job_status: "FAILED", stageCount: list.length });
  }
  if (val.route === "CONFIRM") {
    const details = { required_confirmations: val.requiredConfirmations, required_confirmation_hash: val.confirmationHash, staging_hash: val.prepared.staging_hash };
    return fin({ route: "CONFIRM", jobRows: [row("AWAITING_CONFIRMATION", { error_code: "GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY", error_message: "confirmation needed: " + val.requiredConfirmations.join(", "), error_details: canonicalJson(details), line_count: val.prepared.line_count })], result_code: "GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY", result_message: "confirmation needed: " + val.requiredConfirmations.join(", "), job_status: "AWAITING_CONFIRMATION", stageCount: list.length });
  }
  return fin({ route: "READY", jobRows: [row("READY_TO_COMMIT", { prepared_payload: val.preparedText, line_count: val.prepared.line_count, error_code: null, error_message: null, error_details: null })], result_code: "", result_message: "ready to publish: " + val.prepared.line_count + " lines, " + val.prepared.effect_count + " inventory effects (" + val.prepared.item_effect_count + " ITEM)", job_status: "READY_TO_COMMIT", stageCount: list.length });
};

######## sql_node_PoVr1p4f [sql-node] Read-back: the job (+ stage count)
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.line_count,
       LENGTH(j.prepared_payload) AS prepared_len,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_bulk_line_stage st
         WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}'
           AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.jobId}}'
           AND st.is_deleted = 0) AS stage_count
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.jobId}}
